title: UX Designer
description:
Description:

Johnson & Johnson Medtech is recruiting for a UX Designer. This position is located in Santa Clara, California.

At Johnson & Johnson Medtech, we’re changing the trajectory of health for humanity, using robotics to enhance healthcare providers’ abilities and improve patients’ diagnoses, treatments, and recovery times. Johnson & Johnson Robotics was established in 2020 with the integration of Auris Health, Verb Surgical, C-SATS, and Ethicon. It comprises three key med-tech platforms: Flexible Robotics (MONARCH™), Surgical Robotics (OTTAVA™), and Digital Solutions. Join our collaborative, rapidly growing teams in the San Francisco Bay Area (Redwood City and Santa Clara) and Cincinnati. You’ll collaborate on breakthrough medical technologies that unite multiple subject areas to build a connected digital ecosystem that advances medical professionals’ skills and improves patient outcomes.

Overview

You will join the Human Factors & Experience Design (HFXD) team and implement the UX strategy on the OTTAVA™ surgical robotic system and related experiences.

Working closely with designers, product management and human factors, you will drive the future of surgical robotics. Your day to day will incorporate learning about life-changing surgical procedures, creating designs that progress the robotic roadmap, and crafting the best user experience for the entire medical team.

Surgery is a team sport, so you will be encouraged to become familiar with a range of user types across a variety of clinical specialties. You'll bring your passion for design to a broad range of projects using both internal and external resources.

As a member of the HFXD team reporting to the UX Design Manager, you'll join a team culture that is inclusive, creative and obsessed with improving experiences for our users. We strive to build impactful work while also crafting a positive environment for us all to work in.

Does this sound like an opportunity that fits your skills and ambition? If so, we encourage you to apply below!

Responsibilities

Work within a team of UX designers to produce concepts and UX designs for the OTTAVA surgical robotWork with Industrial Designers, Human Factors Engineers, and User Experience Researchers to promote a unified vision of the User's best experienceCollaborate with teams and partners to dissect requirements and agree on the best features and functionality for the surgical teamPartner with the rest of HFXD to craft the team culture and advance the team's overall impact across experiences that we support

Qualifications:

Education:

Bachelor's or equivalent experience in Human-Computer Interaction, Digital/Visual Design, Industrial Design or other related field

Experience and Skills:

Required:

At least 2 years of experience designing for complex and sophisticated systemsProficiency with typical UX design and prototyping tools (Adobe Suite, Figma, Principal, etc.) Strong portfolio demonstrating an outcome-focused, innovative design processAbility to unpack complex workflows, service interactions and processes to deliver a clean user experienceExperience working with software engineers and product management as inputs to final design approaches

Preferred:

Familiarity with the regulations of the medical or pharmaceutical industry

Other:

This position is based in Santa Clara, and requires the ability to travel up to 10%, international and domestic

The anticipated base pay range for this position is [$101,500] to [$162,500].

The Company maintains highly competitive, performance-based compensation programs. Under current guidelines, this position is eligible for an annual performance bonus in accordance with the terms of the applicable plan. The annual performance bonus is a cash bonus intended to provide an incentive to achieve annual targeted results by rewarding for individual and the corporation’s performance over a calendar/ performance year. Bonuses are awarded at the Company’s discretion on an individual basis.

 Employees may be eligible to participate in Company employee benefit programs such as health insurance, savings plan, pension plan, disability plan, vacation pay, sick time, holiday pay, and work, personal and family time off in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans. Additional information can be found through the link below.

Eligible for benefits to include medical, dental, vision and time off as well as any others as provided for in the applicable Collective Bargaining Agreement.

For additional general information on company benefits, please go to: - https://www.careers.jnj.com/employee-benefits

Johnson & Johnson is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

For more information on how we support the whole health of our employees throughout their wellness, career and life journey, please visit www.careers.jnj.com.

POSITION TITLE: Landscape Designer/Sales AssociateSUPERVISOR'S TITLE: Director of Design and SalesDEPARTMENT: Design/SalesFLSA Status: Exempt
BPI Outdoor Living is an award-winning, privately-owned Landscape Design/Build Firm located in Indianapolis, Indiana. The primary focus of BPI is collaborating with residential clients to design and construct award winning outdoor living spaces and landscapes that enhance their lifestyles and property values. BPI is looking for a career minded individual that is eager to learn and advance in our growing company. The Landscape Designer/Sales Associate will ensure that our client’s needs and desires are being met while also ensuring that BPI’s vision and mission are being fulfilled. You’ll play a crucial role in assisting the design and sales team as well as acting as a trusted advisor to help our clients realize the full potential for their outdoor living spaces and landscapes. You will work closely with a talented team of designers and craftsmen to allow our collaborative vision for our client’s spaces come to life the way we intended. Our talented design team consists of skilled designers, computer savvy individuals and amazing graphic artists. Working with this team will allow for you to be part of award-winning designs and finished projects. Our ability to create trust with clients and define unique, elegant, and functional design solutions allow us to build their spaces typically within a year of the initial designs. This will allow you to be a part of some amazing builds and allow for exposure to new installation techniques.
Think you’re a good “fit”? You will need to bring the following: · Ability to meet with clients and determine unique and functional design solutions based on their needs, desires and budget.· Strong communication skills and the ability to act in a consultative and prescriptive manner. · Collaborate with a team of designers and project managers on project details and deadlines. · Ability to communicate with the team and clients using graphics and renderings. · Understand construction documentation and possess the ability to create production packages. · Effectively communicate with client and team members throughout the design and installation process. · Knowledge of required permitting and construction compliance. · A Bachelor’s degree in Landscape Architecture. · More than three years of professional experience in a landscape architecture/design role. · Previous experience in a sales and performance-driven setting would help you and us. We’re committed to your success, and you’ll find opportunities to grow here with us. You won’t find a corporate ladder to climb, but rather a chance to evolve your skills and abilities as we grow. We’ll give you the tools that you need to excel - we just need you to tell us what you need and why it will help you and the business.

EXPECTATIONS AND ROCKSWithin the first three to six months, this position would accomplish the following “rocks”.· Demonstrate the ability to design unique, functional outdoor spaces based on the client’s needs, desires and budget while maintaining profitability.· Meet or exceed initial sales goals and metrics.· Forge relationships with the production team and ensure the company’s vision and mission are being upheld.
POSITION PURPOSETo act as a trusted expert for our clients. To offer unique, and functional design solutions for their outdoor living spaces and landscapes while be thoughtful about their budgets and investments in their properties. To work with our production team to ensure the overall vision for the outdoor living space is realized. POSITION ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIESTo perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS· Meets with clients to define realistic, unique and functional design solutions.· Meets or exceeds sales goals.· Creates construction documentation and supporting design details for permit requirements.· Collaborates with the production team to ensure the clients expectations and vision are being met.  EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCETo perform this job successfully, an individual must have the following education and/or experience.· Bachelor’s degree in Landscape Architecture.· Three or more years of Landscape Architecture or Design experience.· Professional registration in Landscape Architecture is preferred.· Previous experience in a sales and performance-driven setting is preferred.
KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIESThe requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities required to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.· Efficient in AutoCAD· Basic understanding in Sketchup· Willingness to take on new challenges and responsibilities· Good organization and comfort following a process· Highly motivated and energetic· Strong sense of urgency and problem-solving skills· Strong work ethic
WORKING CONDITIONS AND BENEFITS●  Paid Holidays and PTO package● Health Insurance● Long Term Disability Insurance● Life Insurance● Company Take Home Vehicle● Company matched Simple IRA● Company issued Technology package

title: Senior UX/UI Designer
description:
Applied Medical is a new generation medical device company with a proven business model and commitment to innovation fueled by rapid business growth and expansion. Our company has been developing and manufacturing advanced surgical technologies for over 35 years and has earned a strong reputation for excellence in the healthcare field. Our unique business model, combined with our dedication to delivering the highest quality products, enables team members to contribute in a larger capacity than is possible in typical positions.

Position Description

Senior UX/UI Designer (Other high experience roles considered)

Are you a seasoned UX/UI Designer with a passion for leading, mentoring and creating impactful design solutions? We're seeking an enthusiastic individual to join our dynamic team as a Senior UX/UI Designer. This is your chance to shape the design strategy, mentor a team of junior designers and leave your mark on the future of our company's internal applications.

About Us

At Applied Medical, we are designing vertically integrated enterprise applications that streamline our internal processes, support our ERP systems and bring innovation to our fully custom web and native applications. Our focus is on delivering standardized, information-rich user interfaces that drive efficiency, enhance user experiences and align seamlessly with business objectives.

Role And Responsibilities

As a Senior UX/UI Designer, you will not only be a driving force behind the design strategy and vision for interfaces but also have the opportunity to mentor and guide a team of junior designers. Your expertise will be crucial in the following:

Conducting in-depth user research, usability testing and user interviews to gain valuable insights and validate design decisions. Crafting wireframes, interactive prototypes and visually stunning design mockups using industry-standard tools, such as Figma. Collaborating closely with stakeholders to understand business goals and translate them into effective, user-centered design solutions. Driving the adoption of design thinking methodologies and best practices throughout the organization. Developing and maintaining design systems, style guides and UI pattern libraries to ensure consistency and scalability. Collaborating with our manager to strategically plan, allocate resources, and manage design projects effectively. 

Position Requirements

What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate for this role will bring the following:

A proven track record of collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams including Front-end, Back-end, Business Analysts, Project Management and Application Architects. Proficiency in design tools such as Figma and workflow tools such as Visio or LucidChart, as well as other relevant software. A deep understanding of UX/UI design principles, methodologies and best practices. Exceptional problem-solving and analytical skills to tackle complex design challenges. Familiarity with HTML, CSS and web development principles to facilitate seamless design-to-development handoffs. Experience working within Agile methodologies, adapting designs to evolving project requirements. A passion for mentorship, with the ability to guide and inspire junior designers on their career journey. The ability to manage multiple design projects concurrently while maintaining a high standard of quality. 

Why Join Us

This role isn't just a job – it's an opportunity to lead, mentor and shape the future of design within our organization. As a Senior UX/UI Designer at Applied Medical, you will play a pivotal role in our growth, working on projects that make a real impact. If you're excited about pushing boundaries, fostering innovation and contributing to a collaborative team environment, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now to embark on an exciting journey of design leadership and innovation!

(Please submit your resume, portfolio, and any other relevant materials showcasing your design expertise.)

Benefits

The base compensation range for this role is $95000 - $135000 / year for the position in California. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries in California based on the date of this job posting. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range compensation package during your hiring process.

Please understand that the compensation range may be modified in the future. Each amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation once such amount is earned and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, benefit or any other form of compensation may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law.

The total compensation package for this position may also include [bonuses and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans].

Our total reward package also includes the following:

 Training and mentorship with ongoing learning and development courses On-campus wellness activities Comprehensive medical and dental and vision coverage Education reimbursement program 401(k) program with discretionary employer match Generous vacation accrual and paid holiday schedule

All compensation and benefits are subject to the requirements and restrictions set forth in the applicable plan documents and any written agreements between the parties.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Applied Medical is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, disability (mental and physical), exercising the right to family care and medical leave, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, military or veteran status, national origin, political affiliation, race, religious creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and related medical conditions), or sexual orientation, or any other status protected by federal, state or local laws in the locations where Applied Medical operates.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Tranquility AI is a funded, seed-stage startup helping law enforcement do more with less, without sacrificing fairness, privacy, and accuracy. Time that could be spent solving crime and protecting the public, is instead spent sifting through mounds of data. We want to help law enforcement work faster and smarter using cutting-edge artificial intelligence to quickly gain new insights from their data. Our SaaS harnesses machine learning and generative AI to perform analysis and tell a compelling and accurate story of an event. 
We are looking for an experienced Senior Product Designer to play a pivotal role in our journey. You’ll join the team on the ground floor, designing an innovative generative AI user experience that transforms the way district attorneys and detectives perform their critical tasks. Your work will directly impact the consistency, speed, and accuracy of law enforcement. Apply now to join our team and help shape the future of law enforcement! 
ResponsibilitiesCollaborate on a cross-functional team, working alongside a diverse group of professionals, including software engineers, product managers, and ML scientists.Create and build a user-centered product design that is intuitive, efficient, and effective.Own the end-to-end user experience.Use user feedback and data analysis to improve the product experience.Partner with product managers to define the product vision and roadmap.Translate business requirements into actionable design solutions.Share knowledge and expertise with the broader team.

title: Senior UX Designer
description:
Company Description

When you join Renaissance®, you join a global leader in pre-K–12 education technology! Renaissance’s solutions help educators analyze, customize, and plan personalized learning paths for students, allowing time for what matters—creating energizing learning experiences in the classroom.

Our fiercely passionate employees and educational partners have helped drive phenomenal student growth, with Renaissance solutions being used in over one-third of US schools and in more than 100 countries worldwide.

Every day, we are connected to our mission by exemplifying our values: trust each other, win together, strive for the best, own our actions, and grow and evolve.

Job Description

Our Senior UX Designer will collaborate with UX researchers, product owners, product managers, and engineers to design usable, accessible, and intuitive solutions. You will join an established team of UX designers, researchers, writers, and accessibility pros in delivering experiences that help educators see every student, and students achieve their goals.

This important work brings our mission to accelerate learning to life by empathizing with the needs and behaviors of students and educators and innovating solutions for them through design.

In this role, the Senior UX Designer: 


Partners with design, engineering and product management team members in the execution and delivery of successful products and services, using a customer-focused, iterative design process. Contributes to planning and estimating work individually and for the team and participates in broader work stream coordination and expectation setting. Creates high-quality deliverables and executes based on UX goals and priorities without prescriptive guidance or direction, managing his/her own work to a larger schedule. Works with the UX researcher(s) to identify and recommend the best methods to answer product questions, creates prototypes and other artifacts to facilitate the research sessions, and iterates on designs based on research insights. Proactively leverages, fosters, and extends the use of established UX techniques, templates, presentations, and assets in the creation of UX analysis, solutions, and materials.  Contributes to the adaptation of Renaissance UX tools, methodology, and software, and proposes new solutions or optimizes existing ones. Works collaboratively and communicates effectively with peers and managers. 


Qualifications

For this Senior UX Designer role you should have: 


An attached portfolio to be submitted with the application5-7 years of experience designing interactive experiences from discovery to execution in a web-based software environment and the ability to share prior design work examples. A passion for solving complex problems for educators and students, and a knack for collaboration within and across teams. 


Technical Skills: 


Strong expertise in common design software tools such as Figma (preferred) or Axure. Strong understanding of design research methods to uncover customer insights. Experience with resources such as component libraries, repositories, and internal communication tools. Experience in an Agile environment or juggling multiple projects, deadlines, teams and/or products. General awareness of technology mediums (Javascript, HTML/CSS, etc.) to facilitate productive collaboration with front-end engineers. 


Bonus Points For: 


Experience in EdTech or K-12 Education Fluency in other languages, especially Spanish Familiarity with front-end frameworks (Vue, React, etc.) A degree in Human-Computer Interaction, Design, Information Architecture, Human Factors, Psychology, Cognitive Science, or related field, or equivalent project/portfolio experience. 


Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Salary Range: $90,400 to $124,400 This range is based on national market data and may vary by location.

Benefits:


World Class Health Benefits: Medical, Prescription, Dental, Vision, TelehealthHealth Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts401(k) and Roth 401(k) with company matchPaid Vacation and Sick Time Off12 Paid HolidaysParental Leave (20 total weeks with 14 weeks paid) & Milk Stork programTuition ReimbursementLife & Disability InsuranceWell-being and Employee Assistance Programs

REASONABLE ACCOMMODATIONS

Renaissance also provides reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act and applicable state and local laws. If accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please contact Talent Acquisition.

title: Motion Designer & Video Editor - Social Content
description:
Our Company

Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give everyone—from emerging artists to global brands—everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences! We’re passionate about empowering people to create beautiful and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with customers across every screen.

We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We realize that new ideas can come from everywhere in the organization, and we know the next big idea could be yours!

The Opportunity 

Adobe has amazing stories to tell, from thought leadership to cutting edge products, and we're looking for an experienced motion designer to come help bring them to life. As a member of the Social Editorial team, you'll work with a team of makers to concept and bring to life best-in-class social creative across all social platforms.

What You'll Do 

Conceptualize and produce short-form video content for social channelsCraft best-in-class educational and entertaining content to promote Adobe’s products and mission, including product tutorials, how-to guides, and narrative content. Work with in-house maker team and external partnersCollaborate with team to concept, pitch, and execute larger social activations

What you need to succeed 

8+ years as a motion designer, illustrator, or end-to-end social video makerExperience with motion designExperience in product marketing with ability to implement UI/UX elements into video contentDeep understanding of social platforms and their creative formatsAbility to thrive in a fast-paced, reactive newsroom-style teamWillingness to take on all types of projects, big and smallProficient in Adobe software

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several  U.S. geographic markets, and we pay differently based on those defined markets. The U.S. pay range for this position is $88,300 -- $190,700 annually. Pay within this range varies by work location and may also depend on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for the job location during the hiring process.

At Adobe, for sales roles starting salaries are expressed as total target compensation (TTC = base + commission), and short-term incentives are in the form of sales commission plans. Non-sales roles starting salaries are expressed as base salary and short-term incentives are in the form of the Annual Incentive Plan (AIP).

In addition, certain roles may be eligible for long-term incentives in the form of a new hire equity award.

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law. Learn more.

Adobe aims to make Adobe.com accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com or call (408) 536-3015.

Adobe values a free and open marketplace for all employees and has policies in place to ensure that we do not enter into illegal agreements with other companies to not recruit or hire each other’s employees.

title: Sr. Designer, Title Creative
description:
Company Description

We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our theme parks and consumer experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, MSNBC, CNBC, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, USA Network, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through Universal Filmed Entertainment Group and Universal Studio Group, and have world-renowned theme parks and attractions through Universal Destinations & Experiences. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation.

Here you can be your authentic self. As a company uniquely positioned to educate, entertain and empower through our platforms, Comcast NBCUniversal stands for including everyone. Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion initiatives, coupled with our Corporate Social Responsibility work, is informed by our employees, audiences, park guests and the communities in which we live. We strive to foster a diverse, equitable and inclusive culture where our employees feel supported, embraced and heard. Together, we’ll continue to create and deliver content that reflects the current and ever-changing face of the world.

Job Description

At Peacock, we know life is complicated but believe entertainment shouldn’t be. We envision a more human streaming experience that embraces the entertainment you love. Backed by 100+ years of NBCUniversal legacy, we know how to entertain. We combine this legacy with an insatiable itch for innovation, embracing the data and technologies that challenge the status quo. Our team is never done obsessing over how best to deliver excellence across television, film, sports, news, and more. 

This ambition is a group effort. As challengers at heart, our secret weapon is our talented team of big thinkers, data-driven drivers of growth and innovation. We start by putting people first, embracing empathy and compassion to create a more dynamic, more fulfilling workplace and a better, more enjoyable product. As a company, we embrace the power of transparency and inclusion. We know the best idea can come from anywhere, so we’re committed to creating an organization where we act as one and put ego aside. We are determined to forge the next frontier of streaming through trust, teamwork, and talent.

Peacock, NBCUniversal’s streaming service, is seeking a Sr Designer for its in-house Title Creative team. A visual problem solver and storyteller, the Sr Designer will take ideas from concept to execution stage, in both print and digital advertising, on a variety of platforms and mediums. In support of the Peacock Title Creative team, the Sr Designer will also work within a larger team of creative and marketing professionals, delivering on all company goals and media initiatives.

Responsibilities

Reporting to the Art Director, and working cross-functionally, the Sr Designer shapes the creation of marketing assets that deliver on strategic objectives while maintaining best in class creative and design standardsProjects include: Print and digital Key Art, OOH/DOOH, digital banners and media assets, animations, photoshoot concepts, show logos, character portraits, CRM images, FYC Campaigns, social media graphics, landing pages, presentation decks, and other promotional items.Work with Title Marketing teams on campaign creative design assets, kick-off decks, messaging, and versioning, across multiple platforms and user states.Work with our Performance Marketing and Social Marketing teams to create demand, conversion, to drive customer acquisition and retention.Ensure a high-volume of design elements are finished and delivered accurately and on-time, while working with highly analytical data driven assignments.Ability to pivot and work with great agility in a fast paced and entrepreneurial marketing culture.Keep up to date with Peacocks Title brand guidelines and rules from across the entire Marketing organization to ensure all consumer-facing work maintains a consistent design voice and tone across every platform and touchpoint.Keep current of emerging design trends, with a particular focus on original content promotions within the streaming universe.

Qualifications

Qualifications/Requirements:

 5+ years of relevant work experience; direct-to-consumer or entertainment preferred. Full working knowledge of the Adobe Creative Suite – (from Photoshop to After Effects)

Excellent photo illustration/comping skills.

 Excellent presentation skills. Impeccable typographic skills. Strong editorial sensibilities. Strong knowledge of digital/print production, photography, and photo-retouching. Knowledgeable and resourceful regarding photo and image editing/research. Experience creating animations/storyboards for cinemagraphs and other dynamic media a plus. Ability to give direction/feedback to internal and external partners, while adhering to marketing strategy and brand standardss. Ability to juggle multiple projects in various stages of production and shift focus as needed. Collaborative and a good team player. A proactive mentality, with an understanding of how to keep things moving. This is a hybrid role that reports in person to the NYC office 3x per week.

Hybrid: This position has been designated as hybrid, generally contributing from the office a minimum of three days per week.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.

Salary Range: $115,000 - $135,000 (bonus eligible)

Additional Information

NBCUniversal's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. NBCUniversal will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with relevant legal requirements, including the City of Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative For Hiring Ordinance, where applicable.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access nbcunicareers.com as a result of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by emailing AccessibilitySupport@nbcuni.com.

title: User Experience Designer
description:
OurDate is a date-planning platform that helps couples nurture and sustain their relationships. Our mission is to help people celebrate all occasions in their relationships and make every date unforgettable.
Role DescriptionWe are planning our launch this summer in the San Francisco Bay Area. You will work with the development team and be responsible for conducting product/user testing, improving wireframes and prototypes, performing visual design, and utilizing design thinking to ensure a high-quality user experience.
QualificationsUser Experience (UX) Design, User Research, and Design Thinking skillsAbility to create wireframes and prototypes that effectively communicate design conceptsVisual Design skills, with experience in creating beautiful and engaging user interfacesStrong understanding of usability and UX best practicesExperience with design and prototyping tools such as Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XDExcellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a remote environment.Have a portfolio ready to shareCustomer service, sales, or event planning background is a plus.
About the Internship *Must readIt’s remote work and our team size is around 10-15 people. It’s a 3-month unpaid internship. We set 3 months because it’s enough time for you to put your learning into practice and to show results. From design and marketing to engineering roles, we’ve helped most of the interns for references to new employers and secure their first contract or full-time job. On average 3 to 6 months. If we work together well, we can communicate about that. Some interns are extended until they secure another job. We can’t guarantee interns will get a job after but we have many interns who got their job at other companies because of their hard work and we help them with reference letters and calls with their new employers.We have one-on-one and group sessions but we don’t have organized training sessions. Most interns are already trained and looking for real work experience, so there will be only mentorship. You will work on something depending on your ability, what you want to learn, and your schedule. Company culture? We encourage everyone to participate in the innovation process and be open to putting new ideas to the test. Everyone can contribute something and lead regardless of their title. We can learn from each other and grow towards a common goal. You will be working with other designers, engineers, and marketers.We focus on quality and delivery more than the specific working hours. However, to make sure team communication works well, try to stay present on Slack during 8-6 pm PST. Our team meetings are usually Monday to Friday 8-9 am PST. We use Slack and set up meetings if needed. We understand that you might have other commitments so communication is key to make sure teamwork goes well. We focus on quality and delivery more than the specific working hours. However, to make sure team communication works well, try to stay present on Slack during 8-6 pm PST. What software do we use? Mainly Github, Figma, Miro, Google doc., Google Meet, Zoom, Canva, open for other tools.

title: UX Designer (Mobile), Growth (Hybrid)
description:
Hi, Future Homie!

As a Homie, you'll be part of an unstoppable team that puts customers first, embraces each day with excitement, and strives for excellence in everything you do. We’re revolutionizing the way small businesses manage their teams and grow their business. What this means for you is a shared passion for innovation and making a difference for the people we serve. So what do you say, will you join us on our mission to empower small businesses?

Why We Need You

We are looking for an experienced, mission-driven UX Designer who wants to make a difference in the lives of the small business owners and employees we serve. You’ll report to our Design Sr. Manager for Growth and Monetization and be an integral part of growing our design culture and practice at Homebase. You’ll partner with engineers, product managers, and other designers to shape the Homebase roadmap and deliver meaningful outcomes for our customers.

You’ll look proactively across our different product areas to define how our offerings work together from a pixel perspective and through a workflow, information architecture, and interaction design lens.

You’ll take a leadership role in design critique and help create the long-term vision for the Homebase Design Team, influencing your colleagues through qualitative and quantitative data as well as generally accepted best practices.

The ideal candidate has a background in designing for growth and monetization in mobile products while maintaining a strong user-centered approach. When we design for our customer’s goals, motivations, and behaviors, we will increase our user base and help customers feel good about upgrading in our freemium model.

Experience & Attributes You Bring

You have 3+ years of experience designing in a mobile-first environment (native and web), and mobile best practices are second nature You are insatiably curious and have a strong background in research methods and early-stage concept testing You are not only user-centered in your design thinking but also focus on business impact You are comfortable navigating ambiguity in a fast-paced environment You’ve owned design projects from concept to implementation through sound research, discovery, collaboration, iteration, and partnering with Engineers during execution.You’ve shipped entire end-to-end experiences across web and mobile that start from understanding user needs and contexts.You can clearly express your desired UX metrics and create a plan to develop and evaluate them.You have a high degree of visual polish in your UI design and an understanding of communicating detailed interactions with engineers.You can articulate your design choices with peers and stakeholders clearly and are skilled at giving and receiving design feedback.You’ve demonstrated that you can balance speed and quality, keeping our customers’ needs central to your work.You demonstrate a sense of ownership and accountability for the team’s work and outcomes — the good and the bad.Have a learning mindset. You are intellectually curious with a desire to learn continuously.You demonstrate humility, knowing that our work isn’t about us; it’s about building in service to our customers. You share credit with team members and welcome collaboration, ideas, and feedback.

As a Homie, you are a bar raiser, which means you come with

3-5 years of experience in product design in a consumer-grade mobile environmentA background in Business/Marketing is a plusSignificant experience leading customer discovery and user research effortsFormal education in user experience designAre well-versed in Figma best practices

What We Offer (U.S.)

Colorado Only: Annual salary $145k - 185k, dependant on experience. Stock Options - Everyone is an Owner! 401(k) program + 4% company matchEmployer supplemented Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance Plans20 days of accrued PTO, annual paid holidays, and paid volunteer time offContinued learning and development stipendPaid life insuranceShort- and long-term disability coveragePaid parental leave after 1-year of serviceCommuter benefitsFlexible spending account (FSA) optionsTop-of-the-line equipment and stipend for workspace setup Work from home Monday, Thursday, & Friday Meals provided at our vibrant workspacesTeam offsites and monthly opportunities to engage with fellow Homies

What To Expect During The Interview Process

Meet the Talent Team with Alex V.Meet the Head of Design with Eleanor Ma.Working Session w/ the Design Team: Fadi R., Elaine L., Christan F., Jeff D. (or others)Meet Rachel S., Director of ProductMeet Sammy H., Early Life Product Lead Professional Reference ChecksBackground Check + Offer StageWelcome to the team, Homie💜🎉

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Homebase

At Homebase, we take pride in fostering a welcoming space where every Homie of every gender, age, orientation, culture, and walk of life can be their full selves. Diverse perspectives empower us to build the best-in-class platform for small businesses and hourly shift workers. We recognize that experience comes in many forms, so if you think you’re close to what we’re looking for (even if you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications), we encourage you to apply!

About Us

Our mission is to make small business teams unstoppable.

Homebase is the everything app for hourly teams, with employee scheduling, time clocks, payroll, team communication, HR, and more. More than 100,000 small (but mighty) businesses rely on Homebase to make work radically easy and give their teams superpowers. As the leader in small business team management, Homebase tracked 1+ billion hours for 2.5+ million workers last year.

Homebase is based in San Francisco, Houston, Denver, and Toronto. We are backed by leading venture investors L Catterton Growth, Emerson Collective, Notable Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, Khosla Ventures, Baseline Ventures, Cowboy Ventures, Bedrock Capital, and PLUS Capital.

At Homebase, we value our differences, and we encourage all to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Homebase is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and participant in the U.S. Federal E-Verify program. Accommodations will be provided during the hiring process if needed. Please advise us of any accommodations needed within your application to ensure fair and equitable access throughout the recruitment and selection process.

Interview Recording Notice:

By participating in interviews with Homebase, you consent to using Metaview, a recording and transcription tool, during the interview process. Please be aware that all interviews may be recorded and transcribed to evaluate candidates and ensure the quality of our recruitment process. If you do not consent to be recorded, please inform the Talent Team at the beginning of the call, and appropriate arrangements will be made to accommodate your preference. Your privacy is important to us, and the recorded interviews will only be used for internal evaluation and assessment of candidates.

title: Drafter II, III / Designer I, II
description:
JOB TITLE:  Drafter II, III / Designer I, II

REQUISITION ID:  NUC008B

DEPARTMENT:  Design Engineering

LOCATION:  Wolf Creek – Clyde Cessna

Burlington, KS

PAY RATE: Drafter II: $26.49 / Drafter III: $28.18 / Designer I: $36.65 / Designer II: $39.96

Summary Of Primary Duties And Responsibilities

This position will create designs for plant systems, components, and structures based on design engineer input, design specifications and industry requirements; create drawings and other design documents based on information provided by design engineers, designers, or management; utilize CAD, word processing, and other electronic document tools to create drawings and design documents; utilize various electronic document and information management systems to process design documents, gather data, and perform research; independently check the drafting and designs of others for accuracy, conformance to design specifications, conformance to industry requirements, and conformance to the Wolf Creek Drafting Standards; gather data and research problems related to drafting, work processing and design document management.

Ensure the accuracy and legibility of the design documentation required for the safe and efficient operation of the Wolf Creek Generating Station.Develop standards or drawings for fabrication and modification of facilities.Design simple mechanical, civil, structural, architectural, or electrical systems, components, or structures. (Designer I)Design modification packages that include multiple systems or disciplines.Perform calculations which may include verifying curves and angles, or solution of triangles and other geometric figures, using established mathematical approaches employing basic algebra, geometric and trigonometric formulas.Check drawings and calculations prepared by others to ensure accuracy.Review design documents, drawings and/or calculations for conformity with job specifications, accuracy and applicable codes or standards.Provide technical design assistance to the engineering staff in support of the operating plant.Verify that equipment and "as-built" installations meet design specifications and requirements.Read and interpret schematics, wiring diagrams, flow diagrams and trade standards.Gather data for analytical, economic, and/or technical engineering/planning studies.Determine appropriate materials for specific applications. Prepare documents for competitive bids and recommend selection of vendors.Maintain a working knowledge of information regarding potential chemical hazards of the various media the drafters or design technician utilize in preparing design documents. Follow established safety procedures when operating equipment or performing design tasks within the power block of the operational plant, including awareness of the potential of radiation exposure.Evaluate proposed or alternate design to identify weaknesses or errors, and determine the most efficient, effective alternatives. (Designer II)Perform other duties as assigned by supervision/management.

Education And Experience Requirements

Job requires a high school diploma or GED equivalent.The Drafter II position requires: One year progression from a Drafter I; An Associate Degree in Drafting or equivalent technical Drafting degree and one year of relevant work experience; or Five years of relevant work experienceThe Drafter III position requires: One year progression from a Drafter II position; or An Associate Degree in Drafting or equivalent technical Drafting degree and two years of relevant work experience; or six years of relevant work experience.The Designer I position requires: An Associate degree in Engineering plus two years engineering design experience; or a minimum of six years of equivalent technical experience in engineering design.The Designer II position requires: An Associate degree in Engineering plus four years engineering design experience; or a minimum of eight years of equivalent technical experience in engineering design.

Cognitive Skills

This position requires the ability to: read, analyze, and interpret common scientific and technical journals, financial reports, and legal documents; respond to common inquiries or complaints from customers, regulatory agencies, or members of the business community; write speeches and articles for publication that conform to prescribed style and format; effectively present information to top management, public groups, and/or boards of directors.This position requires the ability to: work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry; apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.This position requires the ability to: solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists; interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.

Vision

This position requires the ability to pass vision requirements associated with company physicals.

Noise

This position requires the ability to work in moderately noisy environments.

Additional Information

 This position requires the ability to operate computer-aided design systems or execute conventional manual drafting and checking methods to ensure availability of accurate design drawings, sketches and modification documents. This position requires a satisfactory work record including good attendance.

Who we are

As a 100% independent and 100% employee-owned agency, we are driven by an independent spirit and believe in the power of the collective. We foster a culture that enables and expects all departments to make our brands impossible to ignore.

The design department

Designers take a transdisciplinary approach to all forms of art and design. They have a strong interest in collectivity and collaboration and welcome complementary perspectives. logos, and other design elements to create deliverables. In short, design is thinking made visual.

Part of what makes a Motion Designer is an insatiable curiosity that always has them asking ‘why?’ and ‘what if?’. It’s this desire to always push for better that makes our Motion Designers so successful. At 22squared, this Motion Designer is a graphic designer with excellent motion expertise. Together with the Lead Designer and Head of Design on design or motion projects, you will combine your superpowers to tackle these exciting challenges together. Our Motion Designers are able to work within all graphic and visual design disciplines in order to bring creative concepts to life through motion. Your approach to creative problem-solving and your insights on culture at large will be an inspiration to those around you, in and out of the Design department. If you’re on the hunt for a place where you’re given the support and freedom to fail, to be inspired, to grow, to take risks. If you’re looking for a creative agency on a mission to create work that’s authentically human and impossible to ignore, well, you've come to the right place. We’re hiring talent now. Acquiring perspective always.

Responsibilities

Actively listens to and understands briefs and responds with articulate ideas and written materials.Taps into other depts early and often to strengthen the work.Asks clarifying questions to understand the assignment, feedback, and client’s business needs.Internally, identifies, expands, and develops outstanding motion design ideas and executions with oversight from the Lead Designer and Head of Design.Collaborates and builds relationships with colleagues across disciplines.Establishes conceptual ideas at the beginning of the project, creating visually and conceptually engaging graphics, animations, and visual elements from conception through production.Takes ownership of work; able to meet timelines and deadlines with moderate supervision.Proactively offers progress updates and seeks guidance where appropriate.Collaborates with Art Directors and Copywriters to ensure visual tone and style are matching.Delivers Impossible to Ignore work from concept to execution.

Management

Capable of working independently in a WFH environment and being held accountable to agency business hours.Proactively communicates any amount of time spent offline for personal appointments as needed with enough lead time.Completes timesheets in a timely manner.

Expectations

Understands and works toward maintaining high quality of craft in motion graphics, graphic design, and attention to detail on creative deliverables.Contributes to both client and internal concepts, storyboards, animations, and deliverables as assigned.Works under the direction of the Lead Designer and Head of Design to create design and/or motion deliverables while maintaining the client’s brand standards.Familiar with motion graphics and video processes from the storyboard phase to animation production.Brings forward provocative proactive ideas based on current industry trends, emerging tech and pop culture.Has a strong knowledge of technology and how design and motion graphics work effectively across mediums.Stays current on the latest industry trends as well as emerging tech.Maturity to understand that with great work comes day-to-day work.Have an entrepreneurial spirit and coachable attitude with an eagerness to improve craft.A detail-oriented and pragmatic problem solver.Participation in new business pitches if necessary.

Culture

Embraces and contributes to diverse and inclusive perspectives and participates in agency DEI programming and initiatives.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Fine Arts, Graphic Design, Digital Media Design, or Advertising/Portfolio school.2+ years agency experience.Exceptional portfolio that demonstrates a strong understanding of animation and graphic design and the ability to think visually with an eye for design, typography, and motion.Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Illustrator, After Effects, and PremiereFamiliarity with Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and Figma. Video editing and 3D experience are a plus!

Company Description

Headquartered in Southern California, Skechers has spent 30 years helping men, women and kids everywhere look and feel good. Developing comfort technologies is at the foundation of all that we do—delivering stylish, innovative, and quality products at a reasonable price. From our diverse footwear offering to a growing range of apparel and accessories, Skechers is a complete lifestyle brand.

With international business representing over half of our total sales, we have product available in more than 180 countries and significant opportunities for continued expansion worldwide. We sell our collections direct to consumers through more than 4,450 Skechers stores around the globe and Skechers e-commerce sites, as well as through a network of third-party partners.

A MULTI-BILLION-DOLLAR GLOBAL LEADER IN THE FOOTWEAR INDUSTRY.

In addition, they'll use their knowledge in respect to 3D, Design, Development and Market Relevance to collaborate with Marketing and Sales personnel on projects to maximize effectiveness and sale-ability. Other duties as assigned.

No

title: Principal Product Designer
description:
About Us

Coalition is the world's first Active Insurance provider designed to help prevent digital risk before it strikes. Founded in 2017, Coalition combines broad insurance coverage with a digital risk assessment and continuous security monitoring to help organizations protect themselves in today’s hyper-connected world.

Opportunities to make an impact with bold thinking are real - and happening daily.

Coalition is looking for a Principal Product Designer, Broker Experience to join our growing Product Design team, reporting to the Head of Product Design. As a strategic design leader, you will spearhead the user experience for Broker-facing products. Collaborating with designers, Product Managers, Engineers, and Business partners, you will identify customer problems and opportunities in the insurance domain, shape the long-term UX vision and own the end-to-end design process to deliver innovative product solutions.

Responsibilities:

Own end-to-end Broker experiences, from inception to execution.Innovate solutions for complex design challenges, grounded in a deep understanding of user needs and business goals.Deliver elegant, intuitive design solutions elevating the overall product experience.Inform product strategy and work with cross-functional partners to plan and prioritize product roadmaps that will solve user problems and business needs.Collaborate closely with engineers to ensure seamless implementation while preserving design vision.Plan and conduct user research to identify and validate user problems and test hypotheses.Take a Service Design mindset to solve user pain points, considering all of their daily workflows.Utilize product analytics and data to inform decisions.Contribute to evolving Coalition’s Design System and visual design language.Champion design thinking, inspire creativity, and foster a culture of feedback.Manage multiple projects concurrently, working in a fast-paced agile process.Drive team-wide impact through mentorship, fostering a culture of growth and collaboration.

Your Background:

7+ years of hands-on product design and UX experience, with a proven track record of delivering exceptional product experiences and a portfolio of successful design projects.Experience designing B2B products, showcasing an understanding of enterprise-level user needs and workflows. Bonus points for experience designing tools that optimize user workflows and enhance efficiency and productivity.Data-driven and able to utilize a mix of qualitative user research and quantitative data to inform decisions and design solutions.High standard for design craft, with expertise in visual design to enhance overall product aesthetics.Outstanding communication skills to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.Highly skilled in Figma and other industry-standard design and prototyping software.Knowledgeable in HTML/CSS, front-end technologies, and Design Systems to bridge the gap between design and implementation.Naturally curious with a drive to push boundaries and explore the possibilities, thriving in ambiguity.Methodical with a strong attention to detail.Self-directed and action-oriented, excelling in a fast-paced startup environment.

Compensation

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. The US base salary for this position ranges from $175,000/year in our lowest geographic market up to $230,000/year in our highest geographic market. Consistent with applicable laws, an employee's pay within this range is based on a number of factors, which include but are not limited to relevant education, skills, job-related knowledge, qualifications, work experience, credentials, and/or geographic location. Your recruiter can share more on target salary for your location during the interview process. Coalition, Inc. reserves the right to modify this range as needed.

Perks

100% medical, dental and vision coverageFlexible PTO policyAnnual home office stipend and WeWork accessMental & physical health wellness programs (One Medical, Headspace, Gympass, and more)!Competitive compensation and opportunity for advancement

Why Coalition?

We’re a remote-first, mission-driven team committed to building a more inclusive culture with people of all different backgrounds. We trust our team members to take responsibility, share ownership, and put in the work to help us in our pursuit to solve digital risk.

Coalition’s exceptional growth stems from its ability to address real-world problems for organizations of all sizes and remain true to our founding values of character, humility, responsibility, purpose, authenticity, and inclusion. We are proud to have been named among Inc.’s Best Workplaces in 2021 and 2023 and one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies in 2022.

We’re always looking for collaborative, inquisitive individuals to join #OurCoalition.

Visit our Newsroom >

Privacy Notice

Coalition is committed to protecting your privacy. We want you to understand what personal information we collect and how we use it. We also want you to understand your options regarding our collection, use, and disclosure of such information and your ability to access and correct such information. As the leading provider of active insurance, Coalition is required to adhere to certain local regulations, including U.S. federal and state laws that protect your information and our use and disclosure of it.

Information submitted, collected, and processed as part of your application is subject to Coalition's Privacy Policy.

Anti-Discrimination Notice

Coalition is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. It is our policy to provide equal opportunity to all individuals seeking employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, medical condition, genetic information, or any other protected category under federal, state, or local law. We also prohibit harassment or discrimination of applicants based on the above-protected categories. This policy covers all aspects of employment, including but not limited to, recruitment, selection, training, promotion, transfer, compensation, demotion, and termination of employment.

Accommodations

Coalition complies with US federal and state disability laws. Our policy is to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities, including applicants and employees unless the accommodation imposes an undue hardship. Contact us by emailing candidateaccommodations@coalitioninc.com if you require reasonable accommodation to complete this application, interview, pre-employment testing, or participating in the employee selection process.

We consider qualified applicants, regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

To all recruitment agencies: Coalition does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Do not forward resumes to our email alias, employees, or other physical or virtual organization locations. Coalition is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Regular Full Time

Denver, CO, US

 Matrix has been named by Zweig Group as a 2023 Best Place to Work and 2023 Hot Firm! 

 About Matrix:  Matrix Design Group, Inc., an employee-owned planning, engineering, and environmental consulting firm is actively seeking a Civil Designer in our Denver, CO office. As an employee-owned company we are committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of diversity, respect and excellence.

Our strengths of service, innovation, and skill are a result of that belief. We have a friendly, collegial, cooperative atmosphere and offer a full range of benefits including medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance; holiday, vacation and sick leave; training and education; 401(k) and an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP). Matrix employees are encouraged to participate in employee wellness programs, social committees, and community outreach programs. We strive to employ highly motivated people with excellent communication and applied problem-solving skills who desire to advance their talents and skills.

 Salary Range:  $65,000.00 to $95,000.00 Annually. Salary will be dependent upon experience.

Job Summary

Responsible for providing engineering design and production support to department for entitlement of multiple types of civil projects. Discipline involves preparing layouts, site, grading, and utility plans, roadway and utility plan and profiles, detail drawings, and other plan sheets and exhibits for a wide variety of infrastructure improvements. This includes land development, transportation, and utility projects for both public and private clients.

Essential Functions

 Under general supervision, with some exercise of judgment, prepares computer-generated engineering drawings according to established standards and procedures.  Prepares civil engineering drawings from rough sketches or from general engineering and design information (verbal instructions and notes) using CADD software programs.  Revises or changes drawings, traces and/or copies existing drawings and completes simple calculations with specific instructions.  Understands and follows the company's standard CADD procedures for layering and standard drawing procedures for sheet layout.  Quality checks all work and work of other designers to ensure complete and accurate plans are provided to engineers.  Maintains schedules and offers progress reports.  Ability to work in an exciting and collaborative team environment.  Completes work within scope, schedule and budget limits. 

Competencies

 Strong problem solving ability: identifies and resolve problems in a timely manner.  Ability to communicate changes effectively.  Strong quality management skills; looks for ways to improve and promote quality, demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness.  Ability to work independently, think critically and proactively, and work efficiently in a team oriented fast-paced environment.  Ability to manage a wide range of responsibilities in a flexible manner.  Willingness to assist with a wide range of projects and work with multiple project managers.  High level of attention to detail.  Strong organizational and time management skills.  Exhibits sound and accurate judgment. 

Supervisory Responsibilities

 None. 

Education And Experience

 Minimum of an Associate’s degree or certification in CADD or the equivalent job experience.  Minimum of 5 years of experience as a CADD technician with civil emphasis.  Experience with: general civil drafting, surface development/manipulation, creating alignments, profiles and cross sections, civil plan set preparation.  Proficient with AutoCAD and standard drafting practices.  Civil 3D experience, including: corridor modeling surface creation, grading and drainage, pipe networks, alignments and profiles. 

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Physical Demands

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand; walk and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.

The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

The expected salary range for this position is displayed in accordance with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act. The final agreed upon compensation is based on individual education, qualifications, experience, and work location.

Any applicant with a qualifying physical or mental disability who believes s/he requires a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process should contact us at 719-575-0100 for assistance.

title: Associate UX/UI Designer
description:
Location: Remote (For Non-Local) or Hybrid (Local to NYC area)

Position Summary

The Associate UX/UI Designer is a valued contributor on the UX/UI Design team. They will craft designs and experiences for one or more cross-functional product teams, while collaborating with fellow designers to ensure consistency across other products. They stay up-to-date with best practices within the UI/UX realm, offer valuable and thoughtful solutions to user pain points, and continuously add value to the design team, their product team, and the organization. They contribute to all phases of the design process including research and prototyping, design execution, and documentation.

Position Responsibilities

Serve as a contributing UX/UI designer for one or more product teams, where you will learn in detail about complex product areas.Work in relation to 2-week scrum cycles to quickly deliver iterative UX/UI improvements and explore new features that meet user and business requirements.Work with product managers, developers, and other cross functional teammates to understand and define product requirements and functional limitations, define user and feature goals, and explore new user experiences.Collaborate with other designers to create familiar and consistent experiences across different products.Advocate for your users in order to reduce friction and challenges in their workflows.Delight users with a modern SaaS product that is efficient, learnable, and thoughtfully interconnected.Contribute to all phases of the in-flight design process from research and prototyping to design execution and documentation; share this process with the design team to facilitate further learning and consistency across products.Contribute to user testing and persona development, workflow mapping, and other research artifacts as applicable.Coordinate with developers to ensure designs and experiences are built as intended. Contribute to the in-house Design System component library and usage handbook.Follow proficient file organization and naming conventions outlined by leadership.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree, certificate, or equivalent work experience Experience in a UI/UX or Product Designer roleWorking knowledge of Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch or other UX/UI design tools – is willing to work exclusively in Figma in this roleBasic user research knowledge: user interviews, ideation, usability testing A basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and Front-End frameworksAn understanding of the core concepts of driving design solutions from concept to delivery

Preferred Qualifications

Exposure to or experience with Pharmacy Benefits, Medical Claims, or Health Insurance companiesExposure to or experience with Enterprise software, SaaS, or other complex/technical design workStrong communication, collaboration, and conflict resolution skillsIntellectual and professional curiosityComfort in a fast-paced, growing environmentStrong attention to detail, best practices, and project management skillsAbility to manage your time and prioritize work across different product teams and the design teamA desire to share work throughout your process with the design team, giving and receiving thoughtful feedback regularly, and contributing to team decision-making and collaboration

Nothing in this position description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

title: Lead UX Designer
description:
Description:

Johnson & Johnson Medtech is recruiting for a Lead UX Designer. This position is located in Santa Clara, California.

At Johnson & Johnson Medtech, we’re changing the trajectory of health for humanity, using robotics to enhance healthcare providers’ abilities and improve patients’ diagnoses, treatments, and recovery times. Johnson & Johnson Robotics was established in 2020 with the integration of Auris Health, Verb Surgical, C-SATS, and Ethicon. It comprises three key med-tech platforms: Flexible Robotics (MONARCH™), Surgical Robotics (OTTAVA™), and Digital Solutions. Join our collaborative, rapidly growing teams in the San Francisco Bay Area (Redwood City and Santa Clara), Cincinnati, and Seattle. You’ll collaborate on breakthrough medical technologies that unite multiple subject areas to build a connected digital ecosystem that advances medical professionals’ skills and improves patient outcomes.

Overview

You will join the Human Factors & Experience Design (HFXD) team and lead all aspects of UX strategy on the OTTAVA™ surgical robotic system and related experiences.

Working closely with designers, product management and human factors, you will drive the future of surgical robotics. Your day to day will incorporate concepting inspiring north stars, aligning designs across the team to the roadmap, and crafting the best user experience for the entire medical team.

Surgery is a team sport, so you will be encouraged to become familiar with a range of user types across a variety of clinical specialties. You'll bring your passion for design to a broad range of projects using both internal and external resources. Although the scope of your work is focused on digital interactions, this role should consider the physical experience as well.

As a member of the HFXD team, you'll also help shape a team culture that is inclusive, creative and obsessed with improving experiences for our users. We strive to create impactful work while also creating a positive environment for us all to work in.

Does this sound like an opportunity that fits your skills and ambition? If so, we encourage you to apply below!

Key Responsibilities:

Lead UX design strategy and vision for the OTTAVA surgical robotCraft visions, concepts and UX direction for multiple robotic systemsAlign the work across a team of UX designers to a single platform experienceWork with Industrial Designers, Human Factors Engineers, and User Experience Researchers to promote a unified vision of the User's best experienceCollaborate with teams and leadership to align experience expectations across multiple releasesMentor and develop talent of other UX Designers within the teamPartner with fellow HFXD leaders to craft the team culture and advance the team's overall impact across experiences that we support

Qualifications:

Education:

Required:

Bachelor's or equivalent experience in Human-Computer Interaction, Digital/Visual Design, Industrial Design or other related field

Preferred:

Masters or other higher level degrees are a plus and will be considered as part of the applicant's professional experience

Required Skills & Experience:

At least 10 years of proven ability to design digital experiences for highly sophisticated systems (or Masters plus 8 years)2+ years leading UX teams (management experience is not necessary)Experience with end-to-end product development with multiple products launchedExperience crafting experiences for medical devices and/or other physical devicesProficiency with typical UX design tools (Adobe Suite, Figma, etc.) Strong portfolio demonstrating an outcome-focused, innovative design process

Preferred:

Familiarity with the regulations of the medical or pharmaceutical industryExperience mentoring and guiding junior designers, supporting to their professional growth and team success

This position is based in Santa Clara, and requires the ability to travel up to 10%, international and domestic

Your vision is ambitious. Just like ours. 

Our people are our success. As one of us, you will contribute to engineering excellence for the high-tech markets of the future, including semiconductors, batteries, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and data centers. At Exyte, you will be part of a global community of challenge seekers who are ambitious and passionate about innovation. Together, we will build on our company’s long history and keep on leading the way to a better world.

Discover your exciting role

Non-Solicitation: We are not currently accepting third-party agency candidates for this position. Any agency candidate submitted to any employee of Exyte may be contacted by Exyte without obligation to the third-party agency.

Job Summary The Senior Designer, Electrical participates in a team environment consisting of engineers and designers to produce construction documents for the following systems: power, lighting, controls, grounding, and the like.

Explore Your Tasks And Responsibilities

Assists in developing electrical documents using architectural background layouts and system performance requirements defined by the project team including the architect, engineer and project manager Assists in pre-design project activities, such as site assessment, site plan review, and verification of as built conditions Assists project team to find optimum system sizing, routing, materials, and space management for equipment and electrical distribution systems Assists senior staff with services during construction, including responding to RFIs, shop drawing and submittal review, and as-built drawings Coordinates with the designs of other trades (architectural and engineering/ internal and external) Assists in developing projects in compliance with engineering codes, standards, principles, relevant specifications and contractual requirements Assists in the production of construction documents under the supervision of a Professional Engineer and coordinate with other disciplines Participates in interdisciplinary review of project deliverables Mentor interns and junior members of project teams Assists in development of construction drawings, specifications, details, schedules and diagrams for electrical and lighting systems Assists in performing quality control reviews of work developed by others Assists in performing calculations: power (load, fault, voltage drop, etc.), lighting, feeder sizing, electrical equipment sizing and the like Assists in performing technical tasks using applicable standards, procedures and codesAssist in providing technical expertise for studies and design effortsOther duties as assigned

Show Your Expertise
