title: Plant 3D/Revit Senior Mechanical Designer
description:
This position allows for a hybrid work schedule with a mix of work spent in office and working remote from home . 

 Under the direction of the Mechanical Project Lead, this position will offer you the opportunity to work with multi-disciplined engineering and design project teams in developing mechanical general arrangement, piping isometric, pipe support, and mechanical equipment layout drawings in a 3-D model  Utilize Autodesk’s AutoCAD Plant 3D and Revit modeling software to generate mechanical design deliverables, BOMs, and commodity lists  Understand and interpret piping & instrumentation diagrams developed using Plant 3D and create physical design consistent with the engineering requirements  Act as the mechanical design team lead in the coordination of detailed design phases for all aspects of an integrated mechanical design model  Resolve clashes and discrepancies in the 3D model and report status  Coordinate and provide guidance to other designers and project team members to ensure a complete and timely design  Independently plan and execute design of mechanical deliverables  Provide guidance as a mentor in the development of less experienced drafters and designers 

Qualifications

We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in the U.S. for this position.

Essential Skills And Experience

 Experienced and proficient with AutoCAD Plant 3D software and other tool sets including AutoCAD Mechanical, MEP, and Map 3D. Experienced and proficient with Navisworks Manage and Revit software including the following: Understanding of the integration aspects of P&IDs with 3D model development  Clash detection resolution  Discrepancy checks between deliverables  Interface with IT Administrators in the development of mechanical deliverable templates and catalogs  Drawing Presentation Set Up  Plant 3D and Revit model data management  Minimum seven years of detailed design experience in the development of mechanical plant design drawings; piping, pipe supports and equipment layout  Proficiency with design software tools in executing 3D plant layout models  Experience in the review of project deliverables and drawing requirements  Experience in the review of vendor drawings and interface points  Ability to interface with engineering and design teams of other disciplines in the plant design process. 
Valued But Not Required Experience

 Autodesk Construction Cloud, MicroStation  Microsoft Office tools

About Sargent & Lundy

Sargent & Lundy is one of the most experienced full-service architect-engineering firms in the world. Founded in 1891, the firm is a global leader in power and energy with expertise in grid modernization, renewable energy, energy storage, nuclear power, and fossil fuels. Sargent & Lundy delivers comprehensive project services—from consulting, design and implementation to construction management, commissioning and operations/maintenance—with an emphasis on quality and safety. The firm serves public and private sector clients in the power and energy, gas distribution, industrial, and government sectors.

 Our Core Values 

Every decision we make is guided by our core values. By upholding these six principles, we support our clients, employees, and community. They are the compass we follow as we continue to grow our business and lead the industry.

Quality – We provide high-quality deliverables and services through an uncompromising focus on peer review, safety, and continuous improvement.

Our People – We value diverse perspectives, encourage professional growth, and are committed to providing a work community where people thrive. Our work is challenging but rewarding.

Our Clients – We deliver value and exceed our clients’ expectations through outstanding customer service, personal accessibility, and clear communication.

Innovation – Since 1891, we have invested in the people, training, tools, and technology needed to quickly adapt in a constantly changing world.

Meaningful Impact – We make a positive impact in the communities where we work and live.

 Awards & Recognition

title: In-Home Designer
description:
Hunter Douglas is the world’s leading manufacturer of window coverings and a major manufacturer of architectural products. We are a brand that you know and trust. With more than 100 years of innovation, we’ve defined our industry with proprietary products that deliver revolutionary style and functionality and can be found in millions of homes and commercial buildings globally.

As a member of the Hunter Douglas family of brands, Smith & Noble has been enhancing homes with custom shades, blinds and drapes for over 30 years. We add the finishing touch that enriches the way homes look and feel. Our roots are as innovators of design, but we aren’t rocket scientists - just great people inspired to provide quality products and serve our customers the right way.

We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What’s yours?

We are offering a $3,000 sign-on bonus for new In-Home Designers who are part of the Andover, MA market.. Terms are as follows: $1500 will be paid out after 30 days and an additional $1,500 will be paid after 60 days of service and good-standing and active employment with Smith & Noble

Do you love design? Do you love sales? Then, consider joining Smith & Noble! 

We are looking for motivated, passionate and resourceful In-Home Designers who can leverage their eye for style to enrich the way that people feel in their home using our custom shades, blinds and drapes.

Therefore, if you are someone who dreams and does, thinks and acts and is inspired to care, we want to chat.

What You'll Do

Conduct in-home design appointments alongside customers and match our premium collection of custom shades, drapes, blinds and shutters to customers’ style preferences and functional needs. Close sales opportunities by building a genuine rapport with customers and demonstrate key features and benefits of Smith & Noble products and service offerings. Showcase our commitment to service and care by following established systems and procedures that reflect positively on the company and build trust with consumers. Use innovative digital selling tools and standards to measure, record, and configure specifications accurately and efficientlyWork collaboratively with fellow designers and internal partners and seek opportunities to continually improve the experience for customers and Smith & Noble team members. Build upon our culture and mission that is built on going the extra mile to exceed customer expectations by demonstrating Creativity, Care, Respect and Integrity. Make yourself accessible for appointments by providing at least 45 hours of availability per week, including a minimum of: three Saturdays or Sundays per month, and one early (8 AM) and two late (5 PM) appointments weekly. Stay up-to-date on product knowledge and standards by using company-provided reference materials and by participating in ongoing trainings and workshops. Strive to meet sales goals by building strong client relationships and demonstrating resourcefulness, adaptability, self-reliance and critical thinking skills. Build professional, productive and collaborative relationships with internal and external partners by expressing thoughts, ideas, concerns in a positive, respectful manner. 

Who You Are

High school diploma or equivalent is a requirement, college degree or some college coursework is preferredIn-home or outside sales experience preferably in custom products/servicesExperience in a retail environment, preferably in home furnishings and décorProficiency using computer software applications and ability to learn new technology and systemsValid driver's license, reliable transportation and insurance coveragePassion for design, sales, and building lifetime customer relationships

What's in it for you?

A consistent flow of qualified leads comprised of consumers who are in the market for custom window treatments and have asked to have a Smith & Noble designer visit their homeA full-time, entrepreneurial job that provides rewarding work-life integrationA generous compensation plan based on commission earnings with no cap and higher commission for any sales that come from leads you generateA training program that consists of initial training and on-going education to ensure that you have the knowledge to maximize your incomeIn-Home Designers at Smith & Noble have the potential to earn over $70,000 after a year, by partnering with our company to drive a combination of company-generated leads as well as self-generated leads. The District Sales Manager can speak more directly to you about the territory’s historical earning potential, but the biggest variable in the equation will be you: the most exciting part of a commissioned sales role is that YOU hold the power to write your own paycheck!Comprehensive benefits, including:Paid time offTraining and ramp-up payMedical, Dental and Vision InsuranceLife InsuranceShort & Long Term Disability InsuranceAD&D Insurance401(k) retirement savings plan, with Company matchGuidance and support from regional and national sales leadersA fun, collegial, supportive, transparent Company culture and employee experience

Please note, all offers presented to candidates are carefully crafted to ensure market competitiveness, equity, and reflect the individual candidate’s education, experience, skills and potential.

Hunter Douglas is an Equal Opportunity Employer and complies with applicable employment laws. EOE/M/F/Vet/Disabled are encouraged to apply.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
At Kyruus Health, our mission is to connect people to the right care, in pursuit of our vision: a better healthcare system- one that's transparent and accessible- where everyone gets the care they need. Our values are at the heart of everything we do:

We care deeply  – We do the right thing even if it’s the harder thing.

We are fiercely driven – We harness our curiosity to pursue continuous improvement and create simple solutions to complex problems.

We lead with respect – We celebrate the individual traits that make each of us unique and seek out diverse voices to listen and learn.

We are accountable – We do what we promise for each other and our customers.

Here’s what that would mean for you in the Senior Product Designer role:

Care: You are an individual who believes in making a positive impact and designing easy to use, inclusive experiences.

Driven:You continuously seek out ways to collect data and feedback to improve the usability of your work.

Respect: You are inquisitive and able to understand and gain knowledge from diverse individuals in a range of settings and situations.

Accountable: You build strong relationships and are able to work through multiple levels of ambiguity by asking the right questions to move efforts forward.

What You Will Do As a Senior Product Designer

You will join a team of design allies working to strengthen the design infrastructure and culture at Kyruus Health.You will be an advocate for our users, leveraging your background and experience to improve and evolve how they find and get care.You will contribute to strategy, definition, and evolution of our products and design system.You will use the many tools in your toolkit to document and communicate your learning and rationale while you iterate on the solutions you build.You will participate in feedback sessions - giving and receiving feedback so we can further refine and improve our products.You will work within multiple teams and balance multiple projects simultaneously. You will report to the Senior Manager, Product Design within the Product Department.

How You Can Grow

title: Piping Designer / Project Manager
description: About This Position: HOERBIGER Rotary Solutions, The Deublin Company, is seeking a Piping Designer / Project Manager to join our team in Waukegan, IL. The Piping Designer is responsible for mechanical piping and pipe support design for steam and condensate systems in paper mills. This includes extensive field work for creation of accurate P&ID’s and PFD’s, providing engineering design support for all stages of capital projects, performing stress analysis modeling for approval and ASME Code Compliance, including reports. Successful candidate should have five years’ experience in steam piping (preferable in paper industry) as well as experience in project management, estimating, equipment procurement, construction management and field supervision. When not traveling, this position will work in the office four days per week with one day per week remote. Position requires 30% to 50% travel (some international); sometimes on short notice. Essential Responsibilities Execute and manage steam and condensate projects, with the process engineer, to achieve the technical, operational and financial goals of the project. Conduct field surveys of existing piping systems for P&ID and PFD creation, piping design and proposal creation. Collaborate with the process engineer to establish and document equipment and piping specifications and sizing requirements to meet the technical and operational requirements of the project. Interact with customers to establish project scoping and development of project requirements. Participate in project meetings with customers to ensure proper execution of projects. Prepare proposals, datasheets, and written specifications. Assist paper mills with troubleshooting. Conduct operator training at customer location. Ensure that the piping installations adhere to the P&IDs. Participate in on-site start-up and post-start-up of system Requirements: Minimum five years’ experience in mechanical process steam piping design. Experience with paper machines, paper drying and paper machine drying equipment is preferred. Completely fluent using AutoCAD for creating and editing P&ID’s and PFD’s. Fluency using AutoCad Plant 3D is preferred. Proficiency with Outlook, MS Word, Excel, Adobe Acrobat. Knowledge of piping, valve, pump, transmitter, insulation and other specifications used in paper mill steam systems. A full and thorough understanding of P&ID’s and PFD. Knowledge of pipe support basics (supporting, guiding and anchoring). Experience with large bore steam piping design. Exceptionally high level of personal responsibility regarding working safely in hazardous environments. Highly organized and systematic in approach to field work and subsequent CAD work to successfully manage projects spanning long time periods. Requires two-year technical degree; BS Mechanical engineering preferred. Ability to read, analyze, and interpret technical literature. Ability to respond to common inquiries or complaints from customers. Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form. Must be able to travel (fly/drive) between 30% to 50% of time; requires valid Driver License. Position works alternately in the office and at customer locations. Customer locations are industrial settings. Candidate must be capable of navigating physically challenging field conditions, including heat, stairs, ladders. Employee Benefits: The Deublin Company offers a stable, team-based environment with opportunity for advancement. Our robust benefits package includes: Medical/Dental/Vision Insurance, Employee Assistance Program, company paid Short- & Long-Term Disability coverage and Life/AD&D Insurance, FSA & HSA, Paid Time Off, Paid Holidays, Educational Assistance, 401(k) Retirement Plan with matching contributions. Company Profile: Deublin Company is the leading manufacturer of Rotating Unions and Electrical Slip Rings- devices that allow the transfer of pressurized fluid or electricity from a stationary source into rotating machinery.  EOE

description:
Description

The Technical Designer will oversee the technical product development process and ensure consistency of fit, construction and quality in the assigned product categories, Responsible for the development of apparel specifications, attending weekly fittings, attending weekly cross functional meetings, and issuing fit comments with direct daily contact to vendors.

What You'll Do:

Responsible for fit, construction, quality, and consistency of assigned product category from development to production, including: Work closely with Product Development to track and maintain approval deadlines. Support and fill in for Lead Technical Designer. Knowledge and ability to lead fittings and make decisions independently. Mentor and assist the assistant and associate technical designers. Other duties and projects as assigned.

High School required a four (4)-year college degree in fashion merchandising/design preferred. Minimum 5 years in technical design, pattern making, or quality assurance, or a combination of education with equivalent work experience. Previous technical design experience is desirable. The Senior Social Media Strategist is directly responsible for the day to day operations essential to the multimedia presence of our gaming and entertainment brands on owned channels such as Facebook, X, TikTok, and Instagram. This includes ideating and posting organic and sponsored content, specifically video, for all of our social media channels.

The Senior Social Media Strategist will be responsible for tracking progress towards monthly and yearly performance goals and will work directly with the Video, Graphic Design, Paid Social, Editorial and Sales Marketing teams.

This role reports into the Senior Manager, Social Media and can be based in LA or SFO.

You Will...

Lead weekly social video ideation meetingsManage Asana workflows for social videos and graphics Schedule/Post organic and sponsored social videos and graphicsExecute weekly/monthly reporting Manage RSS feeds Utilize Dlvr.It, Sprout Social, Later, Meta Business Suite, Instagram, TikTok, X, and Facebook. title: Senior Associate - Social Content Creator, Brand
description:
NYC 299 Park Avenue (22957), United States of America, New York, New YorkSenior Associate - Social Content Creator, Brand

Capital One Brand Creative is looking for an experienced Social Content Creator to bring our brand to life across different audiences, products, channels and types of communication.

Yep, we’re a Fortune 100 finance company—credit cards, banking products & services, and best-in-class technology. But our brand is personable, fun and engaging as we aim to help customers feel at ease on their financial journey.

If you’re a champion of strategic ideas with a passion for internet culture and a customer-focused marketing background, we’d love to hear from you.

What You’ll Do

 Create content. No surprise there, right? Conceptualize, script, shoot and edit short-form video content for our social channels, primarily TikTok, Instagram Reels  Brainstorm big concepts one day and tackle detail-oriented projects the next  Develop and present custom concepts inspired by current trends and storytelling devices.  Execute ideas on-the-go and in real-time at on-site events and experiences.  Step in as on-camera talent when needed  Collaborate with a lot of smart people.  Work with your team—art directors, writers, creative directors, brand and marketing strategists, members of production— to explore social campaign opportunities, extensions, and produce them  Work with your partners—internal marketing and line-of-business  Create marketing content that cuts through the noise.  Monitor ongoing social and cultural conversations and trends unique to each platform, and identify topics that our target audience engages with to implement real-time opportunities  Understand the importance of integrated thinking across channels, products and audiences.  Understand the balance of creating for both the platform and for the brand while adhering to brand guidelines  Be willing to push the process and mindsets of others to create great customer experiences and strengthen our brand  Get stuff done. On time. Every time.  Work autonomously on numerous projects happening at the same time  Deliver error-free work, using best practices with keen attention to detail  Listen to and incorporate feedback  Determine when to use existing solutions or start from scratch, so you can invest your time where it matters.  Understand the goals of a project, take direction well, and ask questions when you need clarity.  Present your work in a compelling way to create support across different audiences and educate on best practices when necessary 

Who You Are

You want to be an EVIDENCE-BASED MARKETER.

 Your curiosity is endless. There’s always something else to learn.  You’re flexible and not afraid of change—in fact, you welcome the challenge.  You share your point of view but seek out what might be missing and listen.  You have big ideas and know the best ones are driven by proof, persistence and patience.  You’re a storyteller. You simplify the complex and compel your audience to act.  You know how to enjoy yourself. While fun isn’t mandatory, it certainly seems to follow you.  You care—about the work, your team and the customers you serve. 

Basic Qualifications

 At least 2 years experience creating digital content for social media  At least 2 years experience writing scripts, shooting video, editing, photography, motion design, and graphic design for social media  At least 2 years experience with GSuite such as GMail, Sheets, Slides or Docs 

Preferred Qualifications

 3+ years of experience delivering and executing social media campaigns  Bachelor’s degree or military experience  3+ years of experience in one or more of the following marketing areas: B2B, Experiential, Performance, or Direct Response Marketing  Experience in the financial services industry

description:
As a Paid Social Media Specialist/Buyer specializing in Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) sales, you'll spearhead the execution of paid social strategies across various platforms, ensuring optimal campaign performance and driving new customer acquisition. This role demands proficiency in campaign planning, launch, optimization, and detailed reporting, with a keen focus on achieving specific Return on Advertising Spend (ROAS) targets. Collaboration with cross-functional teams, including creative and digital, is essential to deliver compelling, audience-relevant content. Reporting to the Global Digital Marketing Manager, you'll leverage your expertise to segment target audiences, strategize campaigns, and analyze performance metrics, contributing to the growth and success of Hyperice's direct markets worldwide.

title: Social Media / Influencer Marketing Specialist
description:
Times10 is a leading creative and digital marketing agency that specializes in creating impactful brand experiences through social media. We are currently seeking a talented and passionate Social Media Influencer Marketing Specialist to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and executing strategic influencer marketing campaigns that drive brand awareness, engagement, and conversions for our clients.
Responsibilities:Influencer Marketing Strategy:Develop effective influencer marketing strategies aligned with clients' goals and target audiences.Identify and research relevant influencers across various social media platforms to reach the desired target demographics.Influencer Relationship Management:Build and maintain strong relationships with influencers, negotiating partnerships, and managing collaborations.Coordinate influencer activations, including content creation, giveaways, sponsored posts, and product reviews.Campaign Planning and Execution:Plan and execute end-to-end influencer marketing campaigns, ensuring timely delivery and seamless coordination with influencers.Collaborate with internal teams to align influencer campaigns with overall marketing strategies and client objectives.Content Creation and Optimization:Provide creative direction and guidance to influencers for content creation that aligns with clients' brand guidelines and objectives.Monitor and optimize influencer content to maximize engagement and drive desired actions from the target audience.Performance Tracking and Reporting:Track and analyze campaign performance metrics, including reach, engagement, conversions, and return on investment (ROI).Prepare comprehensive reports and insights on campaign effectiveness, providing actionable recommendations for future improvements.

Join our innovative team at Times10 and be part of driving impactful influencer marketing strategies for our clients. As a Social Media Influencer Marketing Specialist, you will have the opportunity to shape brand narratives, build relationships with influential personalities, and deliver exceptional results. Apply now and play a key role in creating meaningful connections between brands and their target audiences through the power of influencer marketing.

Become a digital media apprentice. No experience needed. Click "Apply Now" to register & complete our screening.
What does a Digital Media Apprentice do?Digital Marketing is the promotion of brands via the internet and all connected digital properties and applications. A Digital Media role sits at the center of this industry, managing and optimizing ad placements & campaigns across channels. They use their deep knowledge of leading platforms like Google, The Trade Desk & Facebook to drive ad performance. Success in a media role can lead to a very rewarding career, with clear paths to increase your income and overall professional skill set.
Please note, although the role will be exposed to creative teams, this is not a creative position and does not include content creation, design, UX, photo/video or animation based responsibilities.
How does the program work?During your apprenticeship with Catalyte, you will develop and hone your foundational skills in Digital Marketing and Digital Media under tutelage of experienced digital media practitioners and work on real projects at an ad agency, marketing firm, or in some cases an internal marketing team at a large Fortune 100 company. You will learn about digital media platforms, how to create ad campaigns, analyze media reports, data analysis, and how to optimize media campaigns. You will also earn certifications related to the digital marketing industry, which will be essential in growing your future media career.
Who can apply?We’re looking for people who have a passion for marketing and media and are eager to jumpstart their career within the industry. As an apprentice at Catalyte, you will be given all the fundamental skills to work for exciting, fast-paced tech companies in a digital media capacity.Anyone who meets these three criteria can apply:Be at least 18 years oldBasic proficiency using a computer and the internetBe a U.S. citizen or eligible to work in the U.S. for 30 continuous months. Catalyte does not offer visa assistance or sponsorship of any kind.Be available to work full-time from approx 9 am-5 pm, Monday-FridayPay and benefitsYou will receive your local minimum wage for 30 hours per week for the first 8 weeks. Starting in week 9, pay will increase to $40,000/year paid hourly ($19.24), and you will receive additional benefits including paid holidays and time-off, health, vision and dental benefits.

Apprentices advanced through Catalyte’s platform consistently outperform traditional hiring methods in speed, quality, and performance. By giving high-grit, high-aptitude talent the opportunity to launch new careers in the technology industry, Catalyte transforms individuals, companies, and communities. For more information, visit www.catalyte.io.
We are rewiring the talent market and have established a strong leading position, serving world-class companies.
Benefits including Healthcare, Vision, Dental, 401K, and Company Paid Time-Off (including company paid holidays, paid sick leave (6 days), & PTO (6 days)) are available to Catalyte employees. The Pao team will use Toggl to determine the hours you’ve worked and then pay you Bi-weekly via direct deposit to your bank account. Any costs totalling over $25 per month must be pre-approved by Pao in writing. No approval above $25 means no reimbursement above $25. FIRM IMPLEMENTATION.

title: Social Media Marketing Communication Intern

At ASRC Federal we are committed to providing mission-critical services and technical expertise to our customers. From assembling the Orion spacecraft taking humans back to the moon, delivering creative cloud computing and data management solutions, enhancing cybersecurity to keep our nation safe and more, we are looking for team members to share our passion for innovation.

Summer 2024 Internship Summary

This is a remote position but interns must be near the DMV area for mandatory in-person events. 

Join ASRC Federal's internship program and gain hands-on experience in digital marketing and social media management. As a leading provider of innovative solutions to federal defense and civilian agencies, ASRC Federal offers interns the opportunity to contribute to critical national missions while honing their skills in a collaborative environment.

Key Role

Responsibilities include creating engaging content, monitoring trends, collaborating on campaigns, conducting research and analyzing metrics. No extensive work experience is required, but dedication to learning and a passion for emerging technologies is vital. Work closely with mentors and supervisors to explore various technology disciplines and build meaningful connections within the company.

What We’re Looking For

 Create engaging content for ASRC Federal's social media platforms (Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram). Monitor social media channels for trends, news, and relevant discussions. Collaborate with marketing teams on social media campaigns promoting ASRC Federal's brand and initiatives. Conduct research on social media marketing best practices and provide optimization recommendations. Track and analyze social media metrics to measure campaign effectiveness and identify areas for improvement. Support planning and execution of virtual events, including live social media coverage (LinkedIn Lives, Instagram Reels). Stay updated on industry trends and social media platform changes, sharing insights with the team. Enrolled in a bachelor's or master's degree program in marketing, communications, or related field. Possess strong written and verbal communication skills with a focus on detail and creativity. Familiarity with major social media platforms (Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram) required. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a remote team environment. Prior experience with social media/workflow management tools (e.g., Monday.com, Hootsuite, Buffer) preferred. Passion for digital marketing and social media, eager to learn and grow in the field. Commit to at least 15-20 hours per week, Monday through Thursday, for the internship. Remote position, but candidates must be located near the DMV area for mandatory in-person events during the internship. Pursuing a degree in marketing, communications, or related field, with working knowledge in social media, communications, and graphic design. Proactively addresses roadblocks, approaches problem-solving from multiple angles, and thrives in a collaborative team environment.

Calendar: 10-week internship (6/10/24 - 8/15/24)

Hours per Week: 15 - 20 hours per week - Monday through Thursday

Benefits Of ASRC Federal Internship

Dedicated mentor assigned specifically to you Gain professional and technical experience that aligns with your degree Potential opportunity to work with us full-time upon graduation Join a collaborative work environment focused on development and diversity 

Intern Perks

Intern-specific Lunch & Learns to network and build your business acumen Program commencement and completion celebrations ASRC Federal branded gear 

Requirements

Must be a Junior or Senior in an undergrad programCurrently pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Communications, Marketing or concentration in a communications fieldUnfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or transfers for this position

RESPONSIBILITIES: Google Ad Grant ManagementThe Digital Media Coordinator will manage Google Ad Grants a minimum of once every two weeks. “Standard Management” includes, but is not limited to:Writing and testing text adsWriting and testing ad extensionsSelecting new keywords to target qualified trafficSelecting new negative keywords to exclude unqualified trafficPerforming regular quality checks on conversion trackingThe Digital Media Coordinator, Search will also build and manage new campaigns at the request of clients and account teams, delivered through WorkFront. title: Social Media & Marketing Manager
description:
Social Media & Marketing Manager
af&co., based in the heart of San Francisco, is a full-service integrated communications agency with a passion for the hospitality industry. Our clients include restaurants, hotels, food and beverage brands and special events throughout the West Coast. We specialize in media relations, influencer relations, marketing, social media and launch strategy, as well as concept development and operational consulting. Our goals are to provide personalized and expert guidance, build brand awareness, and generate results for our clients. Our approach for each client is fresh, direct, creative and stylish. We inspire people to love our clients as much as we do! For more information, please see our website at www.afandco.com.
The Social Media & Marketing Manager position requires a minimum of 2 years experience, with strong social media management and digital content experience, complemented by sharp communication and leadership skills. The ideal candidate is a self-starter with an eagerness to demonstrate their creativity and strategic thinking. Account Managers are responsible for executing account deliverables whilst maintaining client satisfaction. A passion for food, restaurants and the hospitality industry, as well as a desire to learn more about marketing, social media and brand strategy, are keys to success in this role. 
Please note: To better support our clients needs this is a hybrid position that requires residency in the San Francisco Bay Area. We occasionally support our clients in-person for key events and/or activations.
af&co. Fundamentals
We are looking for someone who:
Is detail-oriented, creative, empathetic, resourceful, tenacious, strategic, an assertive goal-setter and excellent communicatorPossesses a keen interest in and passion for food, restaurants, cocktails, travel, and the hospitality arts and culture in generalHas an understanding and experience with digital/social media platforms and content development (and loves to work in the space)Has excellent writing skills, which can be applied creatively and effectively to anything, including an Instagram post, a case study or client newsletterIs a natural networker and team player with strong social skills who can juggle multiple projects with finesseIs a born story-teller with strong persuasion skillsServes as a knowledgeable mentor to junior colleaguesFosters a fun, friendly, open, drama-free and efficient work environmentBrings strategic rigor and a high quality of work to every account or projectDisplays friendliness, courtesy and attentiveness to client needsIs highly productive and efficient in time managementIs adaptable and responds quickly to internal and external communicationExpertly uses Sprout Social, Klear, Canva, Google Calendar, Docs, Sheets and Slides
Responsibilities
A successful candidate will be able to do the following for up to seven clients:
Manage proactive and reactive communication with each client in a timely manner, ensuring their needs and deadlines are met and tasks are assigned to internal team membersCollaborate with account teams on the planning and execution of client events and activationsDirectly manage client social media profiles, including, but not limited to, Facebook, X, Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, and LinkedIn - includes content creation, from captions to original photographyCreate and manage social media ad campaigns through Facebook Business Manager Build out monthly content calendars Post social media content using Sprout Social and native platforms where neededEngage in influencer outreach and manage influencer campaigns from start to finish When relevant, manage website build-outs with web developer/designer vendors, including writing site-maps, website copy, creating and managing timelines and deadlines, etc.Oversee and manage professional photo and video shoots by identifying and coordinating with local photographers/videographers, creating shot lists, timelines, and reviewing/editing final imagesResponsible for creating social media content on behalf of af&co. clients. Social media content includes: photography, “snackable” video clips, Instagram Stories and Reels.Assist in overall digital brand strategy and messaging for all clientsWork closely with account directors to determine and track account KPIs Create quarterly activity reports and present KPIsMeasure campaign ROI and utilizes data to make informed strategic or tactical recommendationsDevelop a social media playbook in collaboration with account directors that outlines content look-and-feel and overall social media strategy, taking into account current social media trends

Working with a fantastic, tight team of PR and marketing pros who are passionate about our industry and clientsMedical, dental and vision insuranceBusiness development bonusPaid vacation with additional comp timeWork from home four days a weekFive “work from anywhere” days per quarter (working in Pacific Time)Partial reimbursement for cell phone serviceQuarterly dining stipend to conduct industry research401K retirement plan with profit sharing Pre-tax transit benefitThe thrill of working with and experiencing our amazing clients, which often includes enjoying delicious food and beverages!
Salary starts at $65,000 and is commensurate with experience, accomplishments and skills. Please contact Rose Guiliano at work@afandco.com with your resume and a cover letter telling us about:
Why you think you are a fit for this positionSalary expectationsYour restaurant/hotel passion and expertiseFavorite restaurant/chef and why?

title: Social Media Community Manager
description:
Social Media Community Manager Job Description: 100% Remote 40 hours per week, days and some evenings, occasional weekends
The community manager will manage owned social media sites, engage with consumers in social media both proactively and reactively, and be the external voice of our brands while simultaneously acting as the voice of the consumer internally. The community manager will serve as a hub, having the ability to connect personally with consumers (humanize the company), as well as gather and provide feedback to various departments internally (consumer services, brand, legal, tech support, marketing, IT, etc.). The community manager is responsible for overseeing our brands on social media and ratings & reviews, while ensuring internal and external customers receive the best, most effective, efficient, and integrated service experience available. The community manager will implement the social media voice and guidelines of managed brands, manage engagement and interactivity with the consumer audience, and foster a positive consumer experience. This role coordinates with external agency partners (including PR, digital and media), as well as internal brand, ITS, and consumer services teams to support their respective missions, ensuring consistency in voice and cultivating a strong social brand.
 Duties: • Manage social media communities, responding to comments, messages, and inquiries in a timely and professional manner, while fostering positive relationships with followers • Assist in creating and curating engaging content across various social media platforms, including Facebook, X, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, and Pinterest while maintaining a consistent voice and style based on the specific brand • Contribute to creating FAQs, consumer responses and other social media brand content to support ongoing brand activations in respective brand tone and voice • Stay up to date with pop culture, relevant news stories and current events and social trends to ensure timely and relevant content creation and sharing with brand and agency teams • Assist the influencer manager with backend connections related to brand influencer programs, influencer vetting, and reporting metrics • Manage, moderate, and analyze ratings and reviews through tools such as BazaarVoice • Monitor and flag spikes in negative or positive review trends to respective teams as necessary • Report and review key health metrics on an ongoing basis to measure performance, share insights, and recommend optimization strategies to increase engagement and usage • Additional miscellaneous tasks related to the role, dependent on business needs Working Conditions: • Role offers remote working arrangement from any US-based home location • Adequate internet/Wi-Fi service is necessary to complete work duties • Shifts vary between the hours of 8:00am-9:00pm Monday-Friday, depending on assigned schedule • Role requires some weekend (consecutive Saturday/Sunday) coverage between 9:00am-5:00pm, depending on a rotating schedule  Qualifications: • Candidate should hold a Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a actionable insights • Strong understanding of social media platforms, algorithms, and best practices for each channel • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to craft engaging content and adapt for different social media platforms • Experience with social media management, monitoring, and reporting is required • Experience with social media management software (i.e., Sprinklr) is desired • Experience with ratings and reviews moderation and management is a plus • Bilingual in French or Spanish is a plus Comments for Suppliers: 100% Remote 40 hours per week, title: Social Media Manager
description:
Job Description

Trupanion is a leading provider of medical insurance for cats and dogs in North America. Our mission is to help loving, responsible pet owners budget and care for their pets. At Trupanion, we offer a collaborative, casual, and pet-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to be themselves.

Are you a Social Media leader passionate about building brands and community through compelling content, relevant storytelling, and dedicated customer engagement? Are you an experienced social strategist and content leader with proven abilities to use data, insights, and innovation to drive your social strategy for content your audience wants? Do you thrive on collaboration, experimentation, and bringing new approaches to light? Bonus points if you’re maybe, just a little bit, pet obsessed.

As the Manager of the Social Media team your focus will be on two strategic pillars: Social Media and Content. You will bring a deep understanding of how to use organic social media, both proactive & reactive, to drive brand engagement and to create a social presence that stands out from the crowd. You also will bring proven experience creating innovative content that educates, informs, and delights through a variety of mediums.

In this role, you’ll report to the Director of Brand & Content Marketing and be the people leader for an amazing team of brand reputation and social engagement specialists. This team is responsible for creating, delivering, and monitoring content across owned & earned social platforms, including rating & review sites, to engage, educate, respond to, and support our current and future pet-loving members and the veterinary community.

You’ll work closely with leaders from Digital & Direct, Customer, Veterinary, Breeder, and PR/corporate communications to build and maintain a strong voice for Trupanion brand awareness, engagement, and influence. The ideal candidate is a strong communicator who is a creative storyteller, data-fluent, and highly collaborative and who thrives in a fast-moving, fast-growing environment.

This position is a hybrid role open to candidates in the Seattle area, working at least three days out of our casual and pet friendly Seattle office per week.

What You Will Do

Manage an always-evolving organic social strategy that translates into an editorial calendar of campaigns & activations that appeal to several audiences, including pet parents and the veterinary communityBring to life brand messages and pet-focused content aligned with business objectives in creative yet measurable waysLead a team responsible for daily social communications on a variety of topics, including product & service features, general pet health & insurance education, customer support, and overall brand engagementSet performance goals and manage reporting cadences for reach, engagement, and other KPIs that include actionable insights that inform other areas of MarketingKnow and advocate for our audiences to ensure our content strategy serves both company and audience needsHands-on creative development for compelling stories about pet insurance and the power of Trupanion pet insurance for pets, owners, and veterinary communitiesExtend our brand visibility, consistency, voice, and leadership across various social media platforms and conversationsCollaborate with Paid and other Marketing teams to develop a full 360 view editorial calendar, create content, support our partnerships, and execute day-to-day management of campaignsActively monitor the competition as well as the ever-changing landscape of social platforms and trends to identify opportunities, gather insights, and forecast what’s nextHire, coach, and develop a team that supports a rapidly growing and changing business

Qualifications

6-8 years of social media management experience with proven results for growing an audience through strong branded storytelling and strategic initiativesProved experience setting and hitting key social KPIs and demonstrating larger business value of social program3+ years as a people managerExcellent copywriting and communication skills, with history on hands-on content creationProficient in using social media posting and monitoring tools; ideally previous experience with SprinklrConfident, collaborative, and communicative with a desire to thrive in a fast-paced environment.Proactive problem solving and critical, creative thinking.Love of pets and sense of humor

You'll Be Successful In This Role If You

Use data to make decisions and drive performanceLeverage experience to drive innovationThrive in a fast paced environment and adapt quickly to changeHave a strong attention to detailAsk questions, try new things, bring new perspectives

Compensation

The pay range for this position is $85,000 - $95,000Along with the base salary, Trupanion employees may be eligible for monthly bonusesWe want all employees to be invested in Trupanion’s success, so we grant Restricted Stock Units to all new team members. Our new hire grants vest over 4 years.

Additional Information

Benefits and Perks:

Full medical, dental, and vision benefits at no cost to the employeeFour weeks of paid time off and 9 paid float holidays (you can decide which days are most important to you!)Five-week sabbatical after five years of employmentOpen, casual, pet-friendly, and fun office environmentFree medical health insurance for your pet (1 dog or cat)Paid time off to volunteer at nonprofit organizationsSeattle Office Amenities: Free on-site gym, free dog walking services for office pets during business hours, free parking, and paid ORCA cards.

For more information about Trupanion, visit https://trupanion.com/about

Learn more about how Trupanion has revolutionized our industry and the reimbursement model: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vdWZ4KHiPTQ

Trupanion is an equal-opportunity employer and embraces diversity. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, abilities, perspectives, and skills.

We will ensure that individuals are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodations.

description:
Job Description

Characteristics we look for 

An eager, go –getter with a roll up your sleeves “get it done” approach A desire to learn, grow and develop within your role and the organization Genuine interest in digital retail media and the power of effective marketing 

About The Role

The Operational Excellence (OpX) Manager role is positioned to work in lock-step with all order-to-cash related cross-functional teams to create, deliver, train and maintain a seamless and efficient process from pre-sales campaign lead generation to final campaign activation and billing.

The OpX Manager will have various responsibilities in the areas of 

Business Analyst Data Integrity Sales Enablement Sales & Revenue Operations 

The OpX Manager will work closely with leads from 

Sales Client Soltuions Management / Account Management Delivery Ad Operations Retail Business Owners (RBOs) Accounting & Finance Product Onboarding Analytics, Yeild & Business Intelligence 

The OpX Manager will be directly responsible for 

Developing, documenting and maintaining an order-to-cash process that is active and aligned from all areas of the business. Developing, documenting and maintaining a team RASCI that outlines responsibilities across sales, activation & delivery teams. Working within order-to-cash tool sets to ensure Data Integrity & Accuracy, for example FUSE, Salesforce, PIO, Platform and others. Acting in a “Business Analyst” style role to evaluate, create, document and rollout needs around new and existing products and processes. Working with responsible teams to ensure the successful completion of data integrity related activities like Gate Checks, billing windows and any other steps needed to ensure a seamless next step in the process. All cross-functional business process creation, documentation and training. Working with various cross-functional teams to identify SMEs and educate/train in a “train the trainer” style interaction, which will ensure successful activation of necessary processes across the business Special Projects that impact the order-to-cash process, for example Credit Card deprecation. Assisting the Billing Analyst teams on escalation needs, complicated issue resolution and ongoing training of the order-to-cash process to ensure correct steps are maintained and delivered. Working to evaluate areas of the business that can benefit from process improvement through task delegation, including but not limited to the activation of Epsilon India resources as needed. Case Management in Salesforce and PIO for special needs cases not directly related or responsible from other cross-functional teams. 

This role will require strong communications skills, organization, and attention to detail. It’s important that the individual in this role understands its crucial impact on the organization, from big projects to small tasks.

Accountability 

This position will report into the Associate Director, Operational Excellence, who reports up through the SVP of Business Transformation & Onboarding, with regular interaction from all other cross-functional leaders. Performance will be evaluated through successful performance of duties and responsibilities, ability to multitask in a fast-moving culture, organizational skills, and enabling the cross-functional teams to operate with more efficiency and higher output. A critical outcome will also focus on the role’s ability to action tasks quickly and with extreme efficiency to move the new deal pipeline forward. The role will require regular interaction with cross-functinal teams, known and unknown across Epsilon and at times, executive leadership.

Overall, the role will require strong communications skills, organization, and attention to detail. It’s important that the individual in this role understands its crucial impact to the organization, from big projects to small tasks. This role will often interact with executive leadership and the candidate should be excited about growth opportunities, stretch assignments and new areas of exposure across the organization. Finally, it’s critical that the candidate takes an interest in educating themselves on the everchanging landscape of the Retail Media industry, positioning themselves as a go-to resource and knowledge base of internal best practices and external efficiencies that will help the client grow.

Strengths 

With a focus on strategy and support with operational processes, this role will require

Interest in retail, eCommerce and digital advertising In-depth understanding of the MS Office product suite Ability to organize a daily workload by priorities Ability to receive direction from multiple stakeholders at all levels of the organization High level of customer service and EQ (emotional Intelligence) A proactive approach to problem-solving with strong decision making skills Professional level verbal and written communication skills A team-oriented positive approach with an excitement to play an important role in a growth focused global company Ability to work in an agile and fast- pace work environment Strong organization skills – proving the ability to prioritize to ensure deadlines are met Ability to problem solve focused on being solution oriented Excellent interpersonal communication skills Efficient time management skills – able to sustain timeline management and campaign deliverables 

Work Experience

5+ years’ working in a client facing style role 3+ years’ experience in Retail Media industry and/or equivalent experience, primarily within advertising and/or corporate retailer environments 2+ years’ in operational excellence or operational process, project management or product management style role 

Additional Information

About Epsilon

Epsilon is a global advertising and marketing technology company positioned at the center of Publicis Groupe. Epsilon accelerates clients’ ability to harness the power of their first-party data to activate campaigns across channels and devices, with an unparalleled ability to prove outcomes. The company’s industry-leading technology connects advertisers with consumers to drive performance while respecting and protecting consumer privacy. Epsilon’s people-based identity graph allows brands, agencies and publishers to reach real people, not cookies or devices, across the open web. For more information, visit epsilon.com.

When you’re one of us, you get to run with the best. Epsilon’s best-in-class identity gives brands a clear, privacy-safe view of their customers, which they can use across our suite of digital media, messaging and loyalty solutions. We process 400+ billion consumer actions each day and hold many patents of proprietary technology, including real-time modeling languages and consumer privacy advancements. POV: You are an Associate Social Media Producer for @disneyparks. Its 10am on a Tuesday, you’re heading to the park to film a video on the newest Disney Parks attraction opening next month. You made sure to grab your phone, tiny mic and light cube. You are ready to create. As you enter the park you hear the sounds of Main Street U.S.A., you smell the churros and you see the castle. This is where the magic and the storytelling begins. You’re in the zone, and with a little spark of imagination you hit the record button. Whether it’s the thrill of a new attraction in one of our global parks, to meeting a character who has always been a life-long companion, to putting on that favorite T-shirt that conjures the memories from a trip of a lifetime. The Disney Experiences (DX) Social Content Creation team seeks to showcase the magic and tell those stories that bring joy to our fans EVERY DAY!

We’re seeking an individual who strives to create authentic, innovative and compelling content that is highly relevant, drives reputation, and builds relationships. The goal is to find original ways to tell stories that connect Disney Parks to not only our fans but guests and cast members alike. We are looking for someone who stays curious, takes risks and ultimately sparks joy with the stories they can create and tell.

Experience with all aspects of social media and an avid user of various social platforms, is required for this role.

This role is seasonal - approximately 29 hours or less each week (hours are not guaranteed).

What You Will Do

Every day as an Associate Social Media Producer is different, and you may: 


Contribute to a team that is nimble, creative, optimistic, disruptive, and collaborativePartner with communications teams (e.g., Public Relations, Media Relations, Internal Communications) to understand business priorities and objectivesCreate content with tenacity and a strong self-starter process to completion – inclusive of capturing, editing and posting social pieces within a very tight production timeframeBrainstorm, develop and recommend social strategies, platforms, campaigns and content with brand, product, and business priorities top of mindExecute on social media strategy by creating innovative, engaging, and timely content via mobile device or other portable technologies, collaborating with video and technology teams as directedBuild and maintain strong working relationships with Disney partners to establish trust and engagement with other teamsDemonstrate innovation, creativity, and thoughtful integration through all workReview analytics on performances, views, and engagement and make recommendations as needed for future campaignsStay up to date on social media trends and platforms, to better develop creative and innovative content strategies and campaignResearch current events and news relevant to the industry and community that can be promoted and discussedKeep current on internal and external audiences to understand their preferences and how to best inform and engage


Required Qualifications & Skills


Professional experience in social media, video creation and/or related digital marketingProven ability to create original, highly engaging, publishable content through mobile devices and DSLR camerasProficiency with video editing programs such as: Adobe Premiere Pro (Video), Adobe Audition (Audio), and editing Apps such as Adobe Premiere RushExperience capturing content live in the field with a production-forward approach, with appropriate compositions, lighting, and mic audio recordingsVisual scripting, storytelling, and on-location interview experienceSelf-managing ability to capture, edit and facilitate an approval process to post content in real-time and within deadline.Ability to work collaboratively within a group as well as independently with little supervisionClear POV and direction on concepts and creative, while remaining flexible and thoughtful with feedback and revisionsAn affinity for the Disney BrandAbility to work flexible hours including nights and weekendsWillingness to try new things and gain new skills


Preferred Qualifications


Experience/skills in video/digital medium production, basic photography, animation, graphic design and technologyExperience writing social copy for various social media platformsKnowledge and understanding of social media KPIsSolid understanding with Adobe Photoshop and IllustratorFamiliarity with GoPros and 360 Cams

title: (Part-Time Contract) Social Media Community Manager
description:
About Crunchyroll

WE HELP EVERYONE BELONG. IT’S OUR PURPOSE.

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

About The Role

In the role of Social Media Community Manager, you will report to the Senior Manager, Global Social Media Strategy.

We are considering applicants for the location(s) of Dallas, Los Angeles, San Francisco or Remote.

The Social Media Community Manager will help to foster a fun and welcoming community within the Crunchyroll social media ecosystem, including Discord, TikTok, Instagram, and Twitter/X. This includes developing community engagement plans connected to Audience Development goals and engaging with both replies to Crunchyroll content and fan-posted content about Crunchyroll or our streaming series on the Crunchyroll platform. You will maintain brand standards through an authentic voice and meet expectations of licensors via all public-facing communications.

Core Areas of Responsibility

Promote positive fan engagement within the Crunchyroll social media ecosystem by creating frequent community engagement campaigns Moderate and oversee activities on the official Crunchyroll Discord server including a team of moderators to encourage the right tone and ensure all community posts and comments follow guidelines Respond to commonly asked questions with answers and relay information that adhere to Crunchyroll standards Support refining community management policies including banned terms, anti-bullying measures, and Discord community procedures Identify community trends and improvements to appropriate teams Share weekly sentiment reports on important topics that are being discussed by the Crunchyroll community 

About You

We get excited about candidates, like you, because...

You have 3-5 years of experience in digital community management at a global corporate brands You have experience spearheading and building out community management strategies for global corporate brandsYou have experience moderating Discord communities You possess the ability to conceptualize and implement engagement campaigns for digital communities You have an expertise in anime and the anime fandom community You embody the “person of the internet” persona, with understanding of trending topics in mainstream entertainment, and anime fandom communities You’re able to interpret and follow brand guidelines precisely You have basic to intermediate experience with social media analytics to advise on community management strategy

About The Team

Crunchyroll’s Audience Development team of champions manages our social media, editorial, multimedia projects, influencer activations and more. The social media team oversees one of the entertainment industry's largest social media networks, with millions followers across every major platform and continued growth far beyond industry standards.



The Pay Range for this position is listed. Actual pay will vary based on factors including, but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Crunchyroll’s Total Rewards offerings for employees. Other rewards may include performance bonuses, employer matched retirement savings, time-off programs, and progressive health benefits and perks.

Pay Transparency - Culver City, CA

$27.69—$32.61 USD

About Our Values

We want to be everything for someone rather than something for everyone and we do this by living and modeling our values in all that we do. We value

Courage. We believe that when we overcome fear, we enable our best selves. Curiosity. We are curious, which is the gateway to empathy, inclusion, and understanding. Service. We serve our community with humility, enabling joy and belonging for others. Kaizen. We have a growth mindset committed to constant forward progress. 

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion

Our mission of helping people belong reflects our commitment to diversity & inclusion. It's just the way we do business.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Crunchyroll. Pursuant to applicable law, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Crunchyroll, LLC is an independently operated joint venture between US-based Sony Pictures Entertainment, and Japan's Aniplex, a subsidiary of Sony Music Entertainment (Japan) Inc., both subsidiaries of Tokyo-based Sony Group Corporation.

title: Social Media Producer, CBS Sports Soccer (REMOTE)
description:
The CBS Sports Social Media team creates and distributes all content posted from CBS Sports, CBS Sports Network, and CBS Sports Digital's social media channels. In a sports media landscape that's cluttered with noise, we take pride in building creative concepts that cut through with our audience and represent the values of our brand. CBS Sports is expanding its team to continue to lead our coverage of soccer on social media. The ideal candidate will be fluent in the language of North American soccer with an understanding of European soccer as well. Further, they will understand best practices of Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook and X as demonstrated by their portfolio of work. They must understand the most effective strategies on these platforms and be equipped to create content (i.e. videos, graphics) that best play to each platform’s audience.

Post social content in real-time from CBS Sports’ studio and game broadcast feeds. Curate and publish impactful social content. Conceive original creative concepts in reaction to ongoing social conversation in football. Create templated graphics using photoshop. Be able to move the social conversation on through lateral thinking. Manage and develop daily posts for CBS’ soccer accounts across Instagram, TikTok, and X. Coordinate with CBS soccer talent to produce/post video to our social accounts. Work with social designers and video editors to build editorial and promotional content from scratch.

1-3 years relevant experience managing branded social media accountsBachelor's Degree in Electronic Media, Journalism, Communications, or a related fieldFamiliarity with and passion for soccer, especially North American soccerWillingness to cover primetime soccer matches, often on nights and weekendsAbility to work under extremely fast turnaround timesA keen eye for detailA positive, proactive approach towards deliverables and team collaborationExceptional writing ability and a strong understanding of English grammarStrong communication and coordination skills: the ability to collaborate effectively with CBS soccer talent, social designers, and video editors. 

You might also have –

Grasp of Adobe Photoshop and Premiere with a hunger to improve your craft

CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the SEC ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR.

title: Digital Media Specialist
description:
Shannon Strategies is looking for a full-time employee to join our team. As the Digital Media Specialist, you will drive the execution of campaign client projects across email marketing, social media and web platforms. The ideal candidate is experienced in sending e-newsletters, managing social media platforms, building websites and crafting strong messaging.
Who We Are:Shannon Strategies is a woman- and Black-owned communications firm specializing in policy, advocacy, and progressive politics. We work with nonprofits, funders, community-based organizations, lawmakers, and progressive political candidates to mobilize people and enact systemic change.
We combine expertise in communications and marketing with years of experience in the social justice movement space to build power within communities and shift power to people. To be the best advocates, we focus on the details of the budget and legislative process, research policy positions, facilitate community conversations, and prioritize building relationships.
Our clients work across a range of issues including climate action, labor, philanthropy, family economic security, housing, child care and education.
Responsibilities:
Email MarketingCopywrite and proofread content for emails and newslettersBuild and deploy e-blasts on email marketing platforms (e.g. Mailchimp, Constant Contact, Salsa, Sales Force)Implement and grow email audiences through email segmentation, A/B testing and creating new content
Social Media ManagementCurate and post content for various clients across platforms using social media management platforms (e.g. Hootsuite, Buffer, Sprout)Write posts in the brand voice for each clientCaption videos for accessibilityMonitor social media comments and questions, responding as needed to maintain community engagement standardsWork with the team’s Graphic Design and Branding Specialist to determine graphics for social mediaDevelop social media best practices for new clients
Website ManagementDevelop new websites for newly-formed organizations and existing clients in need of a website refresh.Manage client websites via different CMS platforms (e.g. WordPress, Squarespace and Wix).Create scalable digital ads for social media and Google AdWord for campaigns (e.g. fundraising, events, political candidates).Manage the Shannon Strategies website 
Digital StrategyDevelop strategies and long-term action plans with objectives and timeline for clients, including audits to establish baseline metrics.Set up and track analytics across email, social media and websites to track progress and create quarterly reports, including Google Analytics.Event digital marketing plans for client events.
Project ManagementManage client processes and files through various systems (e.g. Google Docs, Box, Dropbox)Attend client meetings, create meeting agendas, prepare and document tasks, and delegate responsibilities as needed to the Shannon Strategies team or client staff. Contribute to the business development of the Shannon Strategies brand
Qualifications:We are looking for a confident, independent thinker. Someone who can think on their feet, problem solve and create content on the fly. You want to work on causes that help disenfranchised communities and does a lot of good for people. 
Storytelling is at the heart of what we do, so we need a team member with cultural competency around social justice. This person is a strong writer with experience creating the right content for the right audience. More importantly, we’re looking for someone willing to learn about today’s most pressing policy issues and find creative ways to share that content.
You are also social media savvy. Yes, that experience includes the years you’ve spent building your personal following. You are eager to try new apps, have the best tips for going ‘live’ and know how to share content in different brand voices. Some of our clients are more fun and engaging, while others are focused on education and persuasion to shift public policy.
We understand that there’s a lot of experience to gain while working on projects. Our goal is to work with an individual who has analytical skills, knows how to troubleshoot and adapt to evolving campaigns. We are looking for someone with a solid skills base who wants to grow professionally and take their skills to the next level. 
Experience level: 3-5 years
Committed to our mission of social, economic, racial and environmental justice.3+ years creating high-quality digital content and campaigns.Proficient across popular social media platforms – Facebook, Twitter, Instagram and LinkedIn.Proficient across email systems like Mailchimp, Constant Contact, Sales Force, Salsa Lab, Network for Good,Experience working across content management systems like WordPress, SquareSpace and Wix and understands SEO rankings.Experience in building web pages and websites.Experience working in Canva for photo and video editing. Experience or interest in working on political or advocacy campaigns.Familiarity with AP style guide.Familiarity with accessibility for digital media, including alt text, captioning videos, screen reading, color testing and website testing.Experienced with multitasking and rapid response to meet deadlines while managing multiple projects.
Compensation and Benefits:Salary: $60,000-$63,000Benefits: Unlimited paid time off (PTO), including 12 paid state and federal holidaysQualified Small Employer Health Reimbursement Arrangement (QSEHRA) 401(k) retirement benefit Monthly cell phone and internet stipend Wellness benefitsProfessional development training
How to apply:A resume is fine, but we prefer to see your LinkedIn profile and portfolio of work. 
Two (2) writing examples: One needs to be a blog post or e-blastThree (3) work samples: Ex. social media posts, videos, websites, IG reels, etc.
Please, no cover letters. We prefer to see the projects you’ve worked on to get a better idea of your writing style and work product.
SUBMIT APPLICATION: https://bit.ly/DigitalMediaSpecialistJobDEADLINE TO APPLY: APRIL 26
Women, people of color, persons with disabilities and LGBTQ individuals are strongly urged to apply.
Shannon Strategies is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact team@shannonstrategies.com.

title: Digital Media Solutions Engineer
description:
Job Title:  Digital Media Solutions Engineer

 Schedule/Location:  Hybrid in Hyattsville, MD

 Terms:  6-month contract w/ potential for extension/conversion

 Overview:  Our client, one of the largest services providers of grocery retail companies in the nation, is seeking a seasoned Digital Media Solutions Engineer to join their team and provide technical expertise in designing, managing, and deploying digital signage solutions in corporate, distribution center, and retail environments. The ideal candidate will lend their expertise in technical support, setup, and installation of Microsoft Teams Rooms technology and AV equipment for the Corporate Offices. There is an expectation that this candidate will have experience working in a fast-paced and challenging environment, leveraging forward-thinking technical engineering expertise with Digital Signage, AV, and Microsoft Teams Rooms systems.

Duties And Responsibilities

 Experience in managing digital signage solutions.  Fundamental knowledge of digital signage systems including content management, device management, and troubleshooting issues to determine root cause and resolution.  Provide 3rd Level technical support, setup and installation of Microsoft Teams Rooms technology and AV equipment.  Project management experience.  Strong organizational and time management skills.  Ability to balance multiple tasks with changing priorities.  Self-starter with ability to work independently.  Customer Service focused.  Ability to communicate clearly written or verbal regarding incident, project, or status updates.  Ability to directly interact with business and vendor partners to manage digital signage requests and projects for the enterprise.  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.  Microsoft Office products experience.  Creation of technical Knowledge Base documents for support and installation teams. 


Qualifications

 B.S. in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or related field or equivalent job experience.  3+ years’ experience with digital signage solutions.  3-5 years extensive technical experience with endpoint management systems (e.g., MS Intune, MS Teams Room Admin Portal).  5+ Years AV support experience (Installation/Configuration).  Knowledge of and experience with Digital Out of Home (DOOH) marketing.  Experience with ServiceNow ticketing system.  Vendor Management Experience.  Microsoft Teams Rooms experience.  Demonstrated experience with managing/deploying and supporting AV technology, Microsoft Teams Room technology, or other related collaborative technologies in a widely distributed enterprise environment.  Ability to develop detailed solution designs and implementation documentation.  Ability to manage own work time and priorities in accordance with aggressive timelines and budgets.  Demonstrated experience working with multiple support partners and external teams to deliver solutions.  Proven record of cultivating strong internal and external relationships that help drive successful intercompany initiatives.  Deliver above-board customer service with a positive attitude! 


Preferred Qualifications

 Strong leadership and communications skills.  Experience with digital signage solutions.  MS Teams Rooms Administration experience (MTRA Portal).  Teams Rooms Configuration and hardware deployment.  AV hardware installation – Displays, Display Mounts, Cable Management.  CTS Certification a plus.
